description:
My flat is in a historical building on a famous street of Galata, 5-10 minutes away from Galata Tower and Taksim Square. It is planned to provide pleasure and accommodation to my guests.

It is 5-10 minutes away from metro, tram, bus and ferry stations.

It is a recently renovated apartment. Round trip from Istiklal Street, Kaleiçi, Karakoy, Eminonu.

reviews.text:
The apartment is really great located, close to restaurants and touristic places but in relatively calm area. There is everything one needs for the stay, the kitchen is fully equipped, the bad is relatively comfortable.
However, the place requires some repair, the faucet on the kitchen leaks, the toilet is not capable of flushing, the shower is only partially working, windows and the balcony door in the sleeping room can not be fully closed.
In addition, even though the area is relatively quite, but the sound isolation in the apartment is very bad, so everything happening on the street one will hear (ear plugs are mandatory).
The worst part for me was a smell, I guess because everyone is smoking bellow the window, there is constant tabaco smell in the place.

Loved the apartment! Felt very homey and very clean. It has everything you need, we did not have any issues. The location for this apartment is absolutely amazing, very close to everything and an easy walk to most of the attractions nearby. The host Gülşen and his colleague Firat were very responsive and always helpful whenever needed. I can highly recommend this place!

We loved the stay. This was our second time and it was just as clean and welcoming as before. The place was comfortable, peaceful and homey, exactly like the pictures. This place is definitely my TOP 1 choice for accommodation in Istanbul.

we had a great time at this apartment on the top floor. Gulsen was extremely helpful, response was super quick and the apartment was exactly as described. he even accommodated us on a variety of connections as well as last minute requests. very professional and considerate.
we will be back here again.

The apartment was very clean and the host is very responsive and helpful... Everything was great but I would have appreciated a wider bathroom space. Other than that nothing actually, very nice apartment I stayed for almost a month. Thank you!

description:
Some apartments are just a place to sleep... but in this one, you feel a family atmosphere, and from the very first moment, you say, "This is what we wanted." 🤍

We have designed our apartments to be places where you can gather with your family in complete privacy, around a coffee pot, a plate of dates, and a comfortable seating area that makes you forget the fatigue of the souk, as if to say: "Please, make yourself at home," to the extent that whenever someone says, "One last cup," the reply is: "Okay, this is the last one." 😉☕🫖🌴🪔

If this is your vibe, send a message to inquire and ask us about:
‼️Special Welcome Offer‼️🎁
We will understand that and will make you a special offer that suits you. God willing, we will respond to you directly within five minutes.

reviews.text: The place was as described. Close to a metro station (about 7 minutes walking), with many shops, grocery store and pharmacies within a couple minutes from the place. The apartment is located in a building with an elevator, although you still need to take a 7-step stairs to get to it. The apartment is equipped with kitchen utensils and we were very pleased to find water bottles for drinking. Very thoughtful! The only minuses I can think about are dust bunnies under the beds and no hairdryer.

The place was really clean and the location is my favorite. It’s just a few steps from a lot of shops, hair salons, diners, grocery, …
The owners are fantastic. They let us check in earlier because we left our previous airbnb at noon. They are very nice and friendly, they bought drinks and snacks for us and the kids. They provided extra blankets and towels, coffee maker, and extra cups for us. There is air conditioning in every room. We stayed at 4 apartments during our trip to Istanbul and this was the best one. I highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul. Also, they know English really well so they are easy to communicate with, and they respond quickly.

Hani was a great host. He was very kind
And easy to communicate with.
The place is big and convenient

The place is located close to Cevaher shopping Center. Walkable to Taksim and Nesantasi
Just note there are 20 stairs on entrance and is not accessible. How ever the place has lift.

konumu gayet güzeldi ulaşımı rahattı. ev sahibi son derece ilgiliydi. iletişimde hiç bir sorun yaşanadık. sürprizi için kendisine çok teşekkür ederiz. çok keyifli bi deneyimdi.

description: Enjoy a modern stay in Beyoğlu — close to Taksim! This stylish apartment offers a bedroom, living room, kitchen, and bathroom with heating and seasonal AC (May–Oct). The building has elevators, 24/7 security, a café, and paid social facilities (gym, pool, and sauna). Starbucks and Sheraton City Center Hotel are next door, and you can find us easily by searching “Safezone Homes” on Google Maps 🌿

reviews.text:
Adam was a great host and was extremely helpful. My flight landed in Istanbul at 6am and Adam kindly allowed me to use the property at 7 am in the morning. After a long flight, this was a very kind gesture. The location is excellent and is a few yards from the Sheraton Hotel where I had Breakfast on most days. The apartment is very clean and is bright and airy. It has 2 modern bathrooms and beautifully fitted kitchen.
Probably one of the best Airbnb units I have been to. The area is well serviced with numerous restaurants and supermarkets and it costs about $3 to Taksim Square. I will be back in Istanbul and will be using the apartment again.
5Stars and highly recommended.

Overall would recommend, comments to help travelers decide if listing is for them.
Pros:
+Adam & co-hosts were amazing! Respectful, accommodating, always meeting requests with a friendly, honest, & prompt response
+Secure building w/helpful security staff (travelled w/two Turkish speakers)
+Check in super easy with detailed info re: the building, amenities, and local recs
+Grocery store, Starbucks, and a few bakeries/cafes within walking distance
+Amenities nice for long stay (washer, etc.)
Cons:
-Cleaning issues on arrival, but Adam offered to fix at no cost
-Location is "city centre" between two hotels, but if you are looking to have easy access to public transport, it is a bit of a hike (Istanbul is hilly) or you should budget for a cab each morning/evening (approx. 100TL each way as of Oct 2024) to get to a more convenient metro/bus stop
-Area a bit noisy some nights, unit looks onto a back courtyard that is not the greatest view
-Beds could be more supportive/comfortable

Very clean, very responsive host, good location, comfortable, all amenities as described, smooth check in and check out
Very good experience, highly recommend

Great location with a great host, all equipments were given for the kitchen and before I came through to the residence, washing up powder, toilet tissues and all kitchen essentials were given. It was beyond my expectations, lovely host manager to let us in early, I asked for extra set of beddings and so on it was provided the same day. Location was perfect! Safe neighbourhood and very active, but when doors closed its really relaxing. Unfortunately I’ve checked out the morning after valentines and left it a little messier than what I usually do and the host was still really respectful and nice. This place is definitely on my recommendation list!

Lovely Apartment, comfy bed. We have found anything needed. Usually we enjoy dinners at the restaurants nearby however we had the breakfast at thime so kitchenete was quite enough. There are nice bars and restaurant around I really liked. Host was super responsive! Thanks for everything

reviews.text: We stayed in this apartment for six days and had a great experience. The location is excellent, just a 5-minute walk from Galataport and Tophane Tram Station, with supermarkets and bakeries nearby. The walk to İstiklal Street is quite steep, so keep that in mind. The apartment was clean, well equipped, and exactly as described. The quiet neighborhood made for a peaceful sleep. The only downside was the lack of an elevator, making it difficult to carry heavy luggage, but this is common in the historic area. The hosts were exceptional: they replied within minutes, fixed a shower drain issue immediately, and arranged a spacious airport transfer for our five suitcases. Their hospitality and responsiveness made our stay even more enjoyable. Overall, I highly recommend this accommodation and would happily stay here again.

We stayed in this lovely home located very close to Galata tower and İstiklal Street. The flat is beautifully renovated on the 2nd floor of a historic building.
Hosts Özgür and Cevat are both very welcoming and helpful (although we only met Özgür; but both of them were ready to reply via airbnb messaging within minutes).
The flat is very nicely furnished and spacious (only the bathroom is on the smaller side), with air con in bedroom and sitting room! It also has a fully functioning kitchen, and TV/sitting room with huge comfortable sofa and even 2 armchairs in the lounge/hall area. The bedroom is nice and big, with fresh linen on the comfortable double bed. The pictures are absolutely true to life!
The area is great, tram station close by, gift shops, groceries and lots of eateries (pastry shop & pide/lahmacun place at the bottom of the street and a very delicious baclava cafe right next door - all highly recommended!) Metro station is a 10-min uphill walk from flat.
Recommend!

Had a lovely stay at the apartment. Ozgur was always pleasant, prompt and responsive in our communication. He was also present at the check-in and even assisted with private transfer from the airport and luggage (the apartment is in a walk-up building). The apartment is as described and matches the photos listed. It was clean, nicely decorated, spacious and conveniently located in a very safe area. There are several local restaurants and small boutiques nearby. Getting around is also very easy. Highly recommend and will return.

My friend and I had a wonderful stay at this apartment! The place was the perfect size for the both of us and looked exactly like the pictures. Everything was very clean and comfortable.
Cevat was a very kind and accommodating host, and he always responded to messages promptly.
The area was also convenient as there are a lot of restaurants nearby and it is super close to the tram station. As two women travelling together, we felt very safe in this area as well.
I would definitely recommend Cevat’s place!

Great location. Walkable to tons of sites and right by the Tram 1 line. Very spacious living room and bonus room. Comfortable bed and pillows. Good water pressure in the shower. Only draw back is lack of places to put anything in bathroom but that’s a minor issue compared to the positives. Host helped arrange rides to/from airport and let us store bags under the stairs as our flight out wasn’t until after 8pm.

description: Welcome to our cozy and comfortable ground floor apartment, perfect for families or groups looking for a home away from home. Located in the vibrant neighborhood of Beyoğlu, our apartment offers all the modern amenities you need for a relaxing stay and is just a 5-minute walk to the famous Istiklal Street. Situated in a charming historical building, this apartment blends classic architecture with modern conveniences.

reviews.text:
I wanted to take a moment to share our experience during our recent stay at your property.
We thoroughly enjoyed the location, which is situated in a lovely neighborhood with friendly people. The proximity to various restaurants made it convenient for quick meal pickups, and convenient having a grocery store nearby
One aspect we did find challenging was the taxi situation; we had to meet them at the corner, as they do not come directly to the door. Despite this, I found joy in exploring the neighborhood on foot, and Taksim was easily accessible.
Additionally, I want to commend the landlord for being exceptionally nice and helpful whenever we needed assistance. One suggestion I would make is the installation of air conditioning, or may be fixing the sitting room AC as the kitchen and dining area tended to get quite hot.

The accommodation was clean, and everything was just as described. The host was a very kind and friendly person; he waited for us until 12:30 a.m. without any complaints (even though we were supposed to arrive at 11).
The only issues were that on the first night we saw a small lizard in one of the rooms—it went into a hole in the corner of the wall and we never saw it again—and the location of the house. The area had very steep slopes, which made it difficult for my mother to get around. To reach the bus stop we had to walk uphill and climb several steps, so it’s not very suitable if you have knee problems.
Apart from that, everything else was excellent. There was a Sunday market right across the street from the house with very affordable goods.

We stayed here for 22 nights and the place almost became our second home. Excellent place to stay. Walkable from Taksim square. Plenty of bang for the buck. Host was very helpful, very responsive. Communicated during Sunday nights assistance in property as well. There is a convience store close by as well, great area. Very accessible location. Very safe, well guarded with multiple doors, password protection too. The place was squeaky clean upon checkin and we really made memories at the location.

Great apartment! Had a wonderful stay the apartment was clean and all the amenities listed were provided. The AC were plant strong I saw a review saying they were weak and I didn’t find that to be the case. There is a super cute bazaar down the street every Sunday and the locals to the area are very kind. Garen is a great host we had a problem with the hot water and his dad was over to fix it in 5 minutes Thank you very much.

This place is located in a good neighbourhood with an easy access to the city centre. Very spacious on the ground floor. The host prepared some snack and drinking water which is very thoughtful! Recommend this place 👍👍

description: Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place.

reviews.text:
This place looked nice in pictures, however the chairs are dirty. The bed is noisy. The bedding was too small for the bed. The shower has mold in between the tiles. The towels were grey not white anymore. The place is situated in a busy touristy area and the area is not very clean. Someone entered the property while we were out and when I asked the host he explained that the cleaning lady needed the vacuum cleaner to clean another apartment. I would’ve liked a heads-up before having someone enter the property while we were out. I felt that was an invasion of my privacy.
The host was very responsive.

“Bedirhan’s apartment is in a quiet, clean building with great restaurants, cafes, and public transportation nearby. The neighborhood is lovely.
The apartment is very clean, with comfortable bedding and a well-equipped kitchen.
Bedirhan is a responsive and helpful host. I highly recommend this apartment and would stay here again.”

We stayed at Bedirhan’s apartment near Ortaköy Mosque and absolutely loved the location! From here, we could easily explore Ortaköy and Beşiktaş on foot, and if you’re feeling more adventurous, you can even walk along the Bosphorus towards Kuruçeşme, Arnavutköy, Bebek, and all the way to Sarıyer.
The apartment looked just like the photos, with everything we needed for a comfortable stay. Overall cleanliness was good, though in a few spots there were small traces left by previous guests—but nothing major. The only downside was a slight damp smell at the building entrance (probably because it’s so close to the sea), but thankfully this wasn’t noticeable inside the apartment at all.
On the plus side, there’s a parking lot right across the street, which makes it very convenient if you’re traveling by car.
We really enjoyed our stay and would happily recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul!

Our stay at this accommodation was absolutely amazing! The place was very clean and comfortable, with a perfect location surrounded by beautiful scenery and close to everything we needed. The host was incredibly understanding and exceptionally helpful, making our stay much easier and more enjoyable. I would definitely choose to stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone!

Evin Ortaköy'ün merkezinde harika bir konumu var. Çok merkezi olmasına rağmen aynı zamanda sessiz olması ayrıca rahatlik. Yıldız parkına yürüyüş mesafesi.
İki çocuğumuzla 2 gece konakladık. Ev cok temizdi. Tek sorun gıcırdayan yataktı.
Bedirhan Bey bizi girişte karşıladı, sorularımıza kısa sürede cevap verdi.
Tavsiye ederim.

description:
Welcome to our cozy, fully renovated apartment in Istanbul’s calm, family-friendly neighborhood.
just 5 minutes from Istiklal Street, Galata Tower, and Galata Port, and 10 minutes to Taksim Square. Featuring 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a spacious dining room, fully equipped kitchen, balcony, and patio. Air-conditioned with separate AC per room, it comfortably hosts up to 6 guests.
Perfect for sightseeing or relaxing.
We look forward to welcoming you!

reviews.text:
The location is excellent – everything is within walking distance, which made exploring the area very convenient. The host was very responsive and helpful, quickly answering any questions we had.
There were some issues with the Wi-Fi – certain websites showed certificate errors, and VPNs wouldn’t connect properly. It’s unclear whether this was due to the local network setup or external connectivity issues. Mobile data worked fine.
The small bathroom was a bit cramped, with some mold on the ceiling. The shower is a corner type, which caused water to spread over the toilet area, requiring cleanup after each use. Additionally, there was a noticeable sewage smell from that bathroom, so we kept the window open to air it out.
That said, everything else was great. We really appreciated the welcome treats and the flexibility with storing our luggage after checkout. Overall, a pleasant stay with some minor inconveniences.

It is really brilliant place! 15 minutes to the Galata tower, but the are is super quite. The apartment totally new and clean, the host is friendly and quick responsive.
The only one “minus” is air conditioning: it is only in the main room, not bedrooms

The house is cozy and neat. We enjoyed our stay there. One of the benefits of staying there is being close to Istiklal Street, Taksim Square, and of course Galata Tower. You can easily access the Tram and Bus to do sightseeing (Around 15 mins on a walk).
All the photos and descriptions are close to the real. You can stay where you see here. The host was always available, and we could find them in Airbnb chat in no time.
We marked this place as our favorite in our next possible trip to Istanbul.

The apartment is at a great location, from a walking distance to public transportation, lots of cafes, bars, and restaurants. It is great value for money. The neighbourhood was peaceful, we had a great stay. The host is responsive, friendly, and helpful.

From the moment we arrived at the house until the final day, there were no issues with the host or the house. The host was friendly, the house was clean and tidy, and everything we needed was available. Our stay at this home was extremely comfortable!

description: Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place.

reviews.text:
The location was convenient for the festival, close to transit, and easy to find via photos. However, check-in instructions were missing, and I had to message on the arrival day to get the exact address. The apartment looked fine visually, but the carpet was so filthy we rolled it up. Hot water was insufficient, and the AC turned on and off on its own, waking me up hot at night. Also, the stairwell is steep and narrow, making large bags hard to carry.
​Since my friend spoke Turkish, the host communicated exclusively with her in Turkish and completely ignored me, even though I was the paying guest and English was listed on his profile. He seemed friendly with her, but I could not assess it myself. When I asked for two extra blankets, he brought only one, which was barely enough. Overall, a convenient location, but cleanliness, amenities, and host communication need work.

For the price you can’t go wrong! Communication with the owner is class. The AirBnB is close to the various bus, tram and metro lines so going about in Istanbul is soooo easy. The rooms were clean and exactly matched the photos. The tiny supermarket (Bekirhan Tekel Shop) is a lifesaver for late night cravings after bar hopping/clubbing or as the first stop of the day - the boys there are super friendly and also connected to the AirBnB. 10/10 recommendation!

We booked accommodation at Miller Homes for 9 nights. Our flight was delayed by 5 hours but when we arrived Numan Bey welcomed us exactly as promised.
The apartment was simply perfect. The bathroom was spotless and shining which was very important for us. Everything was clean, comfortable and well-prepared.
The location of the apartments is excellent within walking distance of Yenikapi metro station and the Aksaray tram which goes towards the Grand Bazaar, Blue Mosque, and Hagia Sophia.
I would definitely recommend Miller Homes. 10/10!

Good stay, good value | responsive host, effective at resolving issues; wants guests to have a good experience | arrived Söğütlüçeşme from Ankara, M1 metro to Yenikapi | dropped off backpack before 2pm check-in | central location, AirCon, hot shower, kitchenette, tea / coffee | onward train from Halkali to Sofia | thank you!

I liked the place. The design of interior is very cute. Also I really didn't expect to find fully equipped kitchen. And it has electric stove, pots, absolutely adorable dishes and coffee cups😊 The host got a grocery store right near the hotel, so you can buy stuff for normal price not being afraid that you are paying double price. I really regret I couldn't stay longer, hopefully next time.

description: Welcome to our cozy and stylish 2+1 apartment in the vibrant Maltepe neighborhood! Perfect for up to 3 guests, this lovely space offers all the comforts of home with the added bonus of beautiful views. The apartment features two comfortable bedrooms, a bright and spacious living room, a fully equipped kitchen, and a modern bathroom, making it ideal for families, friends, or business travelers.

reviews.text:
Demir’s place offers a stunning view of the Istanbul skyline. Not only is it beautifully decorated, but it’s also incredibly comfortable. The couch and bed were both perfect for relaxing. The neighborhood is quiet, peaceful, and the kitchen is well equipped for cooking.
I especially loved how walkable the area is. You can stroll down to the shoreline to catch the sunset or enjoy a peaceful walk through the park. It’s also an easy walk to the vibrant street of Bağdat.
The host was very responsive, always quick to reply and helpful with any questions or needs I had.
It was such a delight to stay here and get a taste of life on the Asian side of Istanbul. I’d absolutely love to return if I come back to the city.

We loved our two week stay here. Felt on top of the world with fantastic views, comfortable space and nice kitchen and bathroom. All was very clean and the a/c works well except one bedroom. The Only issue is there’s a hike up to it from the sea with all the great restaurants, but Ubers work great. We would definitely stay again!

Temizlik olarak bir sorun yoktu, her şey uygundu. İletişim konusunda da herhangi bir problem yaşamadık çok iyi anlaşabilecek ve iletişim kurulabilecek ve ihtiyaçlarınızı da anında karşılayıp yardımcı olan biri. Teşekkür ederiz.

Stayed 4 nights, 3 persons
Place was clean and quiet, view from windows are stunning.
We got clear instructions to find the place, no problems to get keys.
We enjoyed our time, higly recommendable place to stay during visit in Istanbul, especially you like to stay out of the busy central.
Tanju bey her konuda çok yardımcı oldu bizlere , evin eksiklikleri konusunda yardıma hemen koştu , kendisine her an ulaşılabilir.Birdaha istanbula gelecek olursam seve seve tekrar aynı yerde kalırım.

description: We will be happy to welcome you in our suite with a balcony and city view in our facility with 24/7 reception. It is located 3 minutes from Galatasaray high school on Istiklal street. 2 minutes walk to the bus station and 15 minutes to the metro stops. Our rooms have Wi-Fi, air conditioning and central heating. The access to the rooms is via stairs.

reviews.text: Konum olarak merkezi istiklal yürüme mesafesindeydi en büyük artısı , oda da klima çok yanlış bir yere konumlanmış dolap yüzünden oda zor ısınıyordu , balkonun kapısı bozuktu kapanmıyordu , rüzgarlı ve yağmur olduğu için durmadan açılıyordu soğukluk problemi vardı , Odaya hamam böceği geliyordu akşamları , banyoda sıcak su vardı ancak çabuk bitiyordu , oda çok fazla ses alıyordu anayola yakın olduğu için çok fazla araba sesi ve korna sesleri yan odalarda atılan adımların bile sesi geliyor , asansör olmaması kötüydü zaten belirtilmiş ama zordu merdivenler çok dardı çıkması hayli güç oluyor , ama konumundan dolayı fiyat performans diyebilirim .
Fiyata göre konumu çok iyi. Odalar temiz, ulaşımı kolay, metroya ve otobüs duraklarına çok yakın. İlgilerine çok teşekkür ederim.

My husband and I enjoyed this place a lot! It’s perfect walking distance to lots of fun things & the view was beautiful. It was clean & tidy & we would definitely come again. Host was very kind as well.

The place was exactly like the photos, small but cozy and clean.
The family that owns the place was very nice and the helped us in a difficult time.
Overall a great experience in Istanbul!

Temiz ve sıcak bir odamız vardı. Merdiven çok dik olduğu için iniş çıkış biraz sıkıntılı onun dışında bir iki günlük bir konaklama için gayet tercih edilebilir. Aracınızla gidiyorsanız yakında park yeri bulmakta zorlanabilirsiniz ama geç saatlerde bir kaç boş yer oluyor. Genel anlamda memnun kaldık tavsiye ederiz.

description:
A small and efficient apartment awaits you in this wonderful location of Istanbul, the apartment will accommodate you for accommodation and general needs.

We highlight the price performance and location advantage of this apartment, which can accommodate 2 people.

This beautiful apartment, which is 5 minutes from GalataPort, 10 minutes from Taksim, 5 minutes from Karaköy, 10 minutes from Galata Tower, and 5 minutes from the tram and bus stop, will give you the best experience in terms of time.

reviews.text:
This place is an excellent choice for staying in Istanbul. The apartment is within walking distance of main tourist attractions (if you enjoy walking, you can even walk to the Blue Mosque!), and it’s close to bus, metro, and ferry stations. The apartment was clean and as shown in the pictures.
Tarik is an amazing host, always very responsive! We had an issue with the bathroom light, and he fixed it quickly. Later, we experienced an electrical problem, which he also fixed within five minutes. He gave us great recommendations on what to see and where to eat! Amazing!
The only downside is that the calls for prayer are loud inside the apartment, and for light sleepers like me, I had to wake up every night at 4AM because of the noise. Overall, a great place - highly recommend!

Overall a good stay. Tarik was a lovely host. Very responsive at any time and I felt very cared for. the apartment is in a very convenient location for food, bars and transport (tram 2 minutes away, metro 10, ferry 15 by foot). apartment itself spacious and clean. unfortunately the mattress is horrible soft sponge, which made for very difficult sleep. Bed sheets and wifi were also very low quality.

The apartment had all the amenities as described and was comfortable. Location is great and accessible and the hosts (Fatih) was very helpful and prompt in his communication especially when I requested for a bigger towel. I had a pleasant stay :)

Evde konaklama deneyimim gerçekten harikaydı. Öncelikle evin temizliği mükemmeldi; her köşe pırıl pırıl ve düzenliydi. Giriş yaptığım andan itibaren hijyenik bir ortamda olduğumu hissettim. Ev sahibi ise beklentilerimin çok ötesindeydi. Son derece ilgili, hoşgörülü ve yardımsever bir tutum sergiledi. Konaklama süresince ihtiyacım olan her konuda hızlıca yardımcı oldu ve güler yüzlü bir şekilde tüm sorularımı yanıtladı. İhtiyaçlarımı önceden tahmin edip hazırlıklı olmaları gerçekten çok etkileyiciydi. Ayrıca, çevredeki mekanlar ve ulaşım hakkında verdikleri detaylı bilgiler sayesinde çok rahat ettim. Evin konumu Tophane tramvay istasyonuna 5dakikalık bir konumda yerleştiğinden dolayı ulaşım çok rahatdı.Evde kaldığım süre boyunca kendimi hem güvende hem de evimde gibi hissettim. Kesinlikle tavsiye ederim!

In general it is a good place to stay. It is located in a bustling and dynamic neighborhood with lots of things to see and to hang out, but the street of the flat is fairly quiet.
The apartment itself matches pictures and has all the amenities, but I personally found it quite dusty and dirty. It was just general dust and dirtiness, which would go away after proper cleaning of the flat.
The second thing, which was annoying for me, are the blinds on the windows. They just don't cover the windows fully and at night you have rays of light coming into the apartment from the street lamp. It was quite disturbing for my sleep. Honestly, my recommendation is to change these blinds and to put there something else, what would cover the windows better.
Overall, it is a good place with the potential for improvement given the points listed above.

description:
The apartment with a balcony is located in one of the most tourist-attracting districts in the world, within walking distance to Galataport and Karaköy, and Taksim, the heart of Beyoğlu.

It is in an area where 24/7 transportation is easily available, you can reach all personal needs within walking distance, and you can access all social areas according to your preferences.

I can help my guests with 24/7 reception service to keep your comfort at the top, where they can stay like their own home.

reviews.text: merhaba, oda da çıkış yaparken beyaz oda/otel terliklerim altı hala beyazdı desem. çok temiz bir oda, harika rahat ve temiz yatak bir güzel bir iletişim. favorilerim de sabır bir işletme.
The host was very responsive, the room was clean, and the location was amazing. It was a pleasant stay overall!
Emre Bey çok ilgili ve güler yüzlüydü. Konum olarak çok merkezi ve kolay bulunabilir. Odalar gayet temiz ve ferah.
Emre had been a great host! Easily provided all neccesary instructions for us to check-in and was also very responsive! Thank you
Everything was fine! Super location near Istiklal Caddesi.

description: Modern, brand-new one-bedroom apartment in a newly rebuilt, earthquake-reinforced building. Only one minute to Osmanbey Metro. Elegant interior with full kitchen, washing machine, smart TV, AC, coffee machine, blackout curtains, and natural gas heating. Sleek bathroom, elevator access, and perfect location near Nişantaşı and Bomonti.

reviews.text:
Unit: the unit was very clean. It is a new building so it has not been fully lived in. It’s not a cozy aesthetic but given I was here for a seminar, it agreed with my focused energy. The bed is very comfortable and the couch (which can serve as a subbed style) was also comfortable. There’re simple amenities like a washer (no dryer), dishwasher, AC/heat, WiFi- and an added bonus of a floor heater. We did not use it much given the weather was nice but for deep winter in Istanbul, can see how it would be quite lovely!
Neighborhood: It can get a bit noisy at night but the windows are noise canceling which has been a real standout feature. The building is on a road that connect two main roads so it does stay quite busy but the upside is it’s quite easy to find a taxi. Tip: use the name for address for the restaurant across the street as it was much easier for drivers to find it.
Our host was very responsive and helpful. Communication was easy and timely. I would stay here again.

Overall, the apartment is in a great location, and both the check-in and check-out processes were smooth and easy.
As someone traveling to a new country and relying on Wi-Fi, it would have been very helpful if the Wi-Fi information had been clearly provided somewhere in the apartment. I ended up having to search for a place with internet access, but unfortunately, many restaurants—even some higher-end ones—either required a Turkish SIM card to access their Wi-Fi or their internet simply wasn't working.
Because the apartment is located in a very busy neighborhood, it was quite noisy at night, which made it difficult to get a good night's sleep.
The cleaning could also be improved. I found some trash left inside the wardrobe, which suggested that the apartment had not been thoroughly cleaned before my arrival.
Overall, it was a convenient place to stay thanks to its excellent location, but addressing these issues would make the experience much better for future guests.

Rezervasyon yapıldığı anda bize ulaşarak çok hızlı bir şekilde iletişime geçildi. Evin konumu gerçekten inanılmaz. Metroya çok yakın, ana caddeye 1 dakika uzaklıkta. Yeni bir bina ve gayet temiz. Günlük ihtiyaçları karşılamak için araç gereçler mevcut. Sadece evin zeminine bir halı veya eve eklenecek terlikler güzel olabilir. Zemin biraz soğuk açıkçası ve ayakkabıyla gezmek yerine terlik olmasını tercih ederdim. Çevresinde eczane ve market gibi tüm olanaklar da aynı şekilde mevcut. Harika bir konaklamaydı, kesinlikle tekrar tercih edeceğiz.

Really enjoyed our stay here. The place was clean, comfortable and had everything we needed. The host was very friendly and helpful, and communication was easy throughout. We had a great experience and would definitely stay again.
Everything was as described - super easy to get in - comfortable stay really enjoyed it.

description:
Welcome to our stylish and comfortable apartment in the heart of Istanbul, just 2 stops from Kadıköy center!

Only a 2-minute walk to Acıbadem Metro Station

4-minute walk to Medipol Hospital

Only 20 minutes on foot to Kadıköy center

A great transportation hub for public transportation and other needs.

Mercedes VITO.

reviews.text:
This is an ok apartment but the experience could be radically improved by fixing small basic things:
- Add shampoo and shower gel as is the common practise in Airbnb apartments
- Add dish washing liquid for washing the dishes manually (I couldn't figure out how the washing machine works)
- Add electric sockets/extension cords
- Add hooks for towels in the bathroom
- Some of the lamps are not working
- Cleaning (there were hairs on the bathroom floor), overall cleanliness can be improved
- I couldn't figure out how the tv works
- Check in instructions could be more clear
- Sponge and kitchen towels should be replaced by new ones before new guests arrive
This is a ground floor apartment, the bedroom facing the street can be noisy, the other bedroom is quiet.

Konumu oldukça iyiydi ve ulaşım kolaydı. Metro çok yakın olduğu için aracımızı yol üstüne park edip her yere rahat gidebildik…Ev sahibi iletişim konusunda çok ilgiliydi..Ev Doğalgazlı olduğu için sıcacıktı hiç üşümedik. Ancak temizlik ile ilgili bazı küçük eksikler vardı, yine de genel olarak memnun kaldık ve tavsiye edilebilir...Herşey için teşekkür ederim Bedirhan ve Arif 🙏

We spent 10 days at Arif’s place while attending doctor appointments, and it truly felt like a home away from home. The apartment is very spacious, and as a family of four, we were extremely comfortable throughout our stay.
We also spent Christmas there, and the kitchen was perfectly equipped for cooking and organizing a family dinner. It had everything we needed. The bathroom was clean and spacious, and all amenities were thoughtfully provided from shampoo to laundry detergent.
I would highly recommend this apartment to anyone looking for a comfortable place for a long stay.
I do have two small suggestions for improvement:
It would be great to strictly not allow smoking, though I understand this depends on the type of guests you want to attract.
The wooden bed in one room was not as comfortable as the bed in the other room, but this may simply come down to personal preference for softer or firmer mattresses.
We are very thankful and you’re doing a great job👏

The apartment looked like the pictures. The location of the house is great, very close to metro so we didn’t have any problems with transportation. Co-host Sena was very helpful and responsive, it was easy to communicate with her. Overall, we loved our stay 👍🏻
Arif such a great host. Just a few steps to the Metro station and bus stop. Pictures are the same as he mentioned. First floor and suitable for kids. Everything is convenient place

description: This centrally located room is just a 5-minute walk from Taksim Square, set on an authentic street where local families live. The room is on the first floor of a restored historical building, and both its window and private balcony face the street.

reviews.text: We had a great stay at this studio apartment in Istanbul! The room was very clean, the bathroom was modern, and the bed was super comfortable. The host left out water, coffee, and some snacks for us, which was such a thoughtful touch. We also really enjoyed having a little balcony to relax on.The location is brilliant—very walk-able to both the metro and bus stations, which made it really easy to get around the city. We followed the host’s advice and used public transport for our entire trip, which worked out perfectly. The only thing to note is that the area can feel a little intimidating at night on the weekend, especially for two girls walking back from the metro, but that’s more about the areas vibe and not something the host can control. Overall, the hosts were extremely responsive and gave us lots of helpful advice for our trip. We really appreciated their support and would definitely recommend this place to others!

The room was exactly as expected from the photos and clean, except few stains in bed covers. The host was very helpful and polite, replied very quickly, give us info about transportation from the airport and places to go near there.
We didn’t like the position of the Airbnb, but it is all the neighbourhood near like this, old houses and trash, maybe you feel weird in the night.
Although it is close to Center and transportation.

even though neighborhood is not the best, place is quite nice. all three of the hosts are very responsive and helpful, no issue with the amenities, kettle, lighting all very good. price is worth it, and the place is close to taksim/istiklal so you can just go wherever you want. bathroom or the bedroom is not the biggest but it's enough. there were little stains on the sheets but I'm sure it's nothing important. thanks to the hosts again.

Great stay.
The studio looks exactly like the photos, it was very clean and well maintained.
The location is perfect, close to everything: public transport, shops and main areas.
The place was comfortable, warm, the air conditioning worked well, and the TV too.
Everything was great. I highly recommend it!

I was very disappointed due to serious lack of hygiene, disruptive noise and negligent hosts.
Bed linen and towels were heavily stained. The hosts sent someone to replace them, who was not polite, understanding, or very helpful (this was my only in-person interaction with the hosts). He offered some that were also dirty and I had to inspect them and choose the least bad ones – even these had hair and pieces of dirt on them. The pillows and mattress cover were never changed.
There was a foul smell in the bathroom and mould around the shower edges. The bidet didn't work properly and nor did the TV channels.
Loud noise coming from other rooms and from the fridge in the room prevented me from sleeping.
The hosts only addressed about half of my complaints, and not well. One of them came to do superficial re-cleaning that was ineffective.
The space itself and the furnishings are decent, and it would be much better if attention is given to the basics of hygiene, maintenance and noise.

description: If you stay in this centrally located place, you will be close to everything as a family. 1 bedroom 2 bed 1+1 luxury apartment with free parking and private security in the Taksim360 project close to Taksim Square, the heart of Istanbul. It is only 5 minutes on foot to Taksim Square and Taksim metro station. 1-minute walk to the bus stop. The apartment on the 2nd floor of the building on the site is very quiet.

reviews.text:
Amazing stay in the heart of Taksim!
We enjoyed staying in Mr Taner place , Apartments was exactly as describe and even more better..

Apartment was lovely, clean and comfortably furnished , kitchen is full with everything that needs..

We had such a wonderful stay! The place was exceptionally clean, tidy, and well taken care of, not something you find everywhere 🤗 It really made us feel comfortable and at home throughout our stay.

I had a wonderful stay here! Taner and Onur went over and beyond to deliver a great service. The place is well decorated, clean and worth the money. I would recommend this place for couples or adults. It’s only 5-10 minutes to walk to Taksim. Everything is as described! Thank you Taner and Onur.

Awesome experience, felt like another home in Istanbul. Host Omer and his mom were exceptionally helpful and made our stay great. Great location, walkable to major places and great waterfront for walks

Ömer was very helpful and kind, he would check in on us regularly seeing if we needed anything. He was very responsive to any inquries we had and also helped us with local recommendations. The place was located in a very accessible area that was pretty central and easy to transport from.

Fiyata göre güzel bir yerdi, temizlikte daha detaya girilebilirdi ama onun dışında bir sıkıntı yaşamadık. İstanbul ayağımızın dibinde, istediğimiz her yere ulaşım sağlayabildik metro sayesinde. Best location, clean and good value for money.

description:
Pia Homes - Nevizade

Would you like a perfect stay in the heart of Istanbul's iconic Taksim district?

This modern space is just a 1-minute walk from Istiklal Street and Taksim Square, surrounded by museums, landmarks, shopping, nightlife, and public transportation.

Important Note: Nevizade is a lively entertainment area. On Friday and Saturday nights, street noise and music may continue late. Guests seeking a quiet stay should consider this.

reviews.text: From the moment I walked into the apartment, I felt an immediate sense of comfort and calm. These apartments are truly stunning—top-tier quality with exceptional attention to detail. Everything is beautifully maintained, and you can feel the care put into creating a warm, welcoming space. The room had thoughtful touches like complimentary coffee and tea, an ironing board with an iron, and a strong hair dryer that had me looking fabulous before checkout. The air conditioning worked perfectly, and every amenity felt intentionally chosen for comfort. The location is absolutely ideal—right in the heart of Taksim, close to markets, shops, and the famous Istiklal Street. You have everything you need at your doorstep. The hosts communicated clearly and were incredibly helpful throughout my stay, making the experience smooth and enjoyable. I was genuinely satisfied with my reservation and highly recommend Pia Homes for anyone wanting quality, comfort, and convenience in Istanbul.

Great apartment right in the centre of Istanbul with everything walkable or a short journey. Host was very friendly and advised me of the check in procedure prior to arrival as well as recommendations on getting there. I was able to leave my stuff there on the day I was leaving as well which was a bonus. Can’t fault the apartment. Very clean and has everything you need with very clean bathroom and very nice bedding.

Konaklama sahibi gerekli her şey için yardımcı oldu ancak odanın yerleri çok pisti çoraplarımın altı inanılmaz kötü oldu ve hediye lokum diye bırakılan lokum neredeyse küflenmişti odada böcekler vardı hijyen anlamında beklentimizi karşılamadı banyoda duşakabin yok banyonun heryeri ıslandı dolayısıyla temizlik anlamında hiç beğenmedik oda temizlenmemişti havlularda bile toz vardı. Konum ulaşılabilir akşam dışardan çok ses geliyor ama konum itibarıyle sesli bir yer problem etmedik 2 saat geç çıkmak istedik ev sahibi müsade etti teşekkür ederiz

In general good place to stay depending what you look for. It was a little too noisy during night time for us but that’s because of lots of pubs and central location of the stay. Clean and fitted description, small room but had everything we needed and A/C was working great. The only negative was a bad WiFi and small bed cover that for us first night was a little problematic. All in all positive:)

The place was in a great location, right in Beyoğlu and close to so many restaurants and nightlife spots. The host was very responsive and brought me a physical room card when my digital key didn’t work. My only downside was the shower, which overflowed and pooled water onto the floor. The bathroom mat got soaked after every shower, so I had to turn the shower head toward the corner to avoid the whole floor getting wet. Other than that, I really enjoyed my stay!

description:
Located in the vibrant Yeldeğirmeni neighborhood of Kadıköy, our apartment is ideal for both short and long stays. The apartment is on the 3nd floor.

The living room is equipped with air conditioning and high-speed internet. Please note that the bedroom does not have air conditioning.

As the windows face the street, some street noise may be heard, especially during the day. Cafés, restaurants, markets, and public transportation are all within walking distance.

reviews.text:
Overall, we had a pleasant stay. The studio is nicely decorated, clean, and well-equipped. The host was friendly and responsive throughout our stay. We had an issue with the induction hob, and the host made every effort to resolve it as quickly as possible.
The apartment is located in a very vibrant neighborhood, which is great for experiencing the local atmosphere. However, it also meant there was a lot of noise from traffic, car horns, garbage trucks etc.. The living room has air conditioning, but it didn't effectively cool the bedroom, which made sleeping a bit uncomfortable.
Despite these drawbacks, we enjoyed our stay and appreciated the host's hospitality and responsiveness.

The place is clean but uncomfortable. There's AC only in the living room and it does NOT reach the bedroom. Had to sleep on the couch because the bedroom was just too hot. Also, the location is quite sketchy, away from the nice part of Kadikoy. The host is unfriendly.
Wonderful stay! Communication with host is excellent, apartment is clean and like in the photos, perfect location.

Very easy to check in. Clean apartment. Nice tv and has everything you need in the kitchen. The neighborhood is very silent. Walkable distance to everything so always a great stay while we’re in kadıköy!

This Airbnb was exceptional and felt more like a luxury apartment hotel than a typical rental. The location was excellent, with easy access to public transportation and plenty of local shops nearby. I'm particularly sensitive to cleanliness, and the hosts truly went above and beyond to ensure everything was spotless and well maintained. The design of the house is very inspiring and well thought. Thank you very much!

description:
✨ Welcome to Nişantaşı Life Residence Apartments ✨
A brand-new, earthquake-resistant building with 24/7 security and CCTV surveillance for complete comfort and safety.
Spacious, elegant apartments fully air-conditioned, with a modern elevator.
📍 Prime location in the heart of Nişantaşı, just steps away from restaurants, shopping centers, and public transport.

The perfect choice for families and guests seeking comfort and luxury in Istanbul.

reviews.text: Most attentive host and staff. Amazing location, less than 10 min walk to city centre Nişantaşı. Other than TV not being comparable with apple devices, I was happy with everything else. Comfortable bed and beddings. Thank you Tarik & Sinan for always being there for me. Teşekkürler 🙏🏼
The room was spacious, bright, quiet, and comfortable. There was a pedestrian shopping street nearby

It’s a great place, this is the 2nd time for me there.
Tarek is responsive and the place is clean and quite
I will probably go again next time I visit Istanbul
Had a nice stay at Tarik’s - the location is in a pretty quiet area, but walkable to many busy areas. Great location and friendly support.

Unser Aufenthalt war wirklich sehr schön. Die Unterkunft war genauso wie beschrieben – sauber, gemütlich und sehr gut ausgestattet. Wir haben uns von Anfang an wohlgefühlt. Auch die Kommunikation verlief unkompliziert und freundlich. Wir würden jederzeit gerne wiederkommen und können die Unterkunft definitiv weiterempfehlen.

description:
Modern duplex apartment with private terrace and architectural design, located in one of the most popular locations in Istanbul, in one of the most fashionable districts in the world, in the center of Kadıköy, within walking distance to the coast

With 24/7 transportation, you can reach anywhere in Istanbul, from shopping to entertainment, from coastal walks on the Bosphorus to places with Bosphorus views, you can reach many social areas in minutes

I offer a pleasant experience with 24/7 support and helpful services while staying at home temperature

reviews.text: I had a wonderful stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was great and made it easy to get around and enjoy the area. Fatih was a very kind and responsive host, making the whole experience smooth. I truly enjoyed my time here and would definitely stay again. Highly recommend to anyone visiting!

Great stay in Kadikoy! Fatih was responsive and communicative throughout — check-in was smooth, and when we accidentally got locked out at night, he sent a locksmith immediately and covered the cost. Much appreciated.
The apartment was clean, well-maintained, and worked perfectly for our group of three (couple + adult daughter). Loved the thoughtful touches like extension cords for all our devices.
Location is hard to beat — right in the heart of Kadikoy, walkable to everything, and a few minutes from the ferry to the European side. Lively area with great restaurants and shops; the apartment itself stayed quiet despite the buzz outside.
A few practical notes
- entrance is at a restaurant so entry can be a bit awkward, it's 4 flights up with no elevator (mentioned in listing), and the inner door locks automatically (no warning posted) — just be mindful of that.
Would recommend!

We had a fantastic stay at this apartment in Kadıköy. The host was excellent with communication from start to finish—always responsive, helpful, and made everything very easy for us.
The location really couldn’t be better, right in the heart of Kadıköy with plenty of shops, cafes, and restaurants all within walking distance. Having a supermarket on the same street was also incredibly convenient.
The apartment itself was modern, clean, and well-maintained, with everything we needed for a comfortable stay. One of the highlights was definitely the roof terrace—it was such a lovely spot to relax, whether enjoying a coffee in the morning or a glass of wine in the evening, with great views over the area.
Overall, a brilliant stay and we would absolutely recommend it to anyone visiting Istanbul.

The place was easy to find and is located in a vibrant, lively neighbourhood, which we appreciated. The location is convenient and a definite highlight.
However, while we liked the area, the house itself could be improved. The room we stayed in had a noticeable smell of smoke, which was not ideal for us, although the upstairs area was fine. The bathroom also had an unpleasant odor coming from the pipes, and the deodorant placed in the sink seemed to make the smell worse rather than better.
At night, noise from the restaurants and shops downstairs could be heard until around 3 am, which made it difficult to rest. What bothered us most was the main entrance door being made of frosted glass. The outside staircase light flickered from about 11 pm until morning, and the light shone through the door. We couldn’t close it fully as we had children sleeping upstairs.
Overall, the location is great, but these issues affected our comfort.

We had a wonderful stay! The location is truly amazing, such cozy streets and honestly my favorite neighborhood in Istanbul.
Communication was very good, friendly and helpful. We were even allowed to check out later, which we really appreciated.
The apartment had many useful amenities like towels and other necessities, which made our stay comfortable. It was reasonably clean and the space itself is beautiful and spacious. The rooftop terrace is a big plus and makes it suitable for different types of guests (friends, couples, etc.)
Also: we loved the cozy wall art! 😊
Thank you for the stay!

description:
Our bright, spacious, and modern private villa is suitable for up to 10 guests.
Just a 2-min walk from the metro, it provides both convenience and quiet residential comfort.

Designed with natural light, comfort, and quiet, this villa features three
large bedrooms, an open-plan daybed area,
modern bathrooms, a small kitchen, and a private garden with on-site parking. Perfect for families, groups, and business travelers seeking a peaceful yet highly connected stay in Istanbul.

reviews.text: This property has its quirks like any other and lots of stairs but overall we had a wonderful time in the city because of the neighborhood and it's amenities. We had not planned to make any meals in house which worked out perfectly for our family. However, if you had planned to make large meals it might prove more difficult given the layout and kitchenette amenities. I would absolutely stay again especially given the ease of communication and kindness shown by the hosts. They were easy to work with and provided assistance at a moments notice. It's a beautiful large building and a lot of privacy if you wanted to sit out back and relax. Well worthy of consideration while staying in the city.

We had a great stay at Yasemin’s place. The house is in a great neighborhood of Istanbul with super easy access to Metro station and in walking distance to many shops and 3 nice malls. Parking is not always easy in Istanbul so private parking place makes a huge difference if you have car. The house is spacious and comfortable. In addition to all, Yasemin is very helpful and proactive if any help needed.

I had a great stay at this villa. Despite being right in the city center, it’s impressively quiet and peaceful. The location is excellent. Easy access to the subway makes getting around effortless, and Kanyon Shopping Mall is just a short walk away for dining, shopping, and essentials. The house itself is large and spacious. The beds were comfortable. I really enjoyed getting some work done in the wooden rooftop area. Check-in check-out was easy. The villa was well mantained and clean. Recommended.

Kerim and Yasemin's place was very spacious, cosy and well maintained. It was nice finding a spot near Levent that accomodated me with my dog Jax. The location is superb and parking is super easy. Thanks again for hosting me :)

We had a wonderful stay at the house; the location was extremely convenient and central, allowing us to head anywhere in the city easily. Great calm street while in walking distance to Kanyon.
The house was perfect for a whole family stay, lots of space for us to get ready while preparing to head to a family wedding.
Yasmin was super responsive and made sure we had everything we needed. Biggest thank you!

description:

What You Need to Know
• All my belongings are new
• 24-hour hot/cold water
• Local market is set up on the street on Saturdays

Common areas have a washing machine & dryer, iron, vacuum cleaner, medicine cabinet
