reviews.text: Had a great stay here! The room was clean, comfortable, and looked just like the photos. The location was really convenient for getting around Istanbul. Ahmet was friendly, quick to respond, and made check-in very easy. I also liked having access to the kitchen. I’d definitely stay here again if I’m back in Istanbul
Ev fotoğraflardaki gibiydi, tertemiz ve çok rahattı. Ev sahibi de ilgiliydi, hiçbir sorun yaşamadık. Tekrar tercih ederiz 🙏
It's really good to stay. The design of the room is very nice and comfortable. Host revelant and responds quickly. 5/5
Tam olarak anlatıldığı gibi ve fotoğrafkardaki gibiydi hiçbir sorun yaşamadım konum olarak da duraklara çok yakın herkese tavsiye ederim☺️☺️
konum ve fiyat cok iyiydi.

description:
Welcome to a great stay in this fully equipped and chic 1-bedroom apt, newly restored historical building in the heart of Galata..This unit is very centrally located next to major tourist attractions, right in the center of Istanbul. You can see the Galata Tower from the window.

It has every basic amenity you will need and is designed to make you feel "Your home away from home" from the moment you step-in.

Elevator and luggage drop-off allowed.

Wish you experience a wonderful stay HERE !

reviews.text: The location is perfect. Host was very instructive and helpful. The place is right near the Galata and different cozy coffee shops to have great breakfast. There was also a parking space, that was very helpful for us. Thanks for an amazing stay❤️🫶

Konaklamamız gerçekten çok keyifli geçti. Ev hem çok temiz hem de oldukça düzenliydi. İçeride ihtiyaç duyabileceğimiz tüm detaylar düşünülmüş ve bu da konaklamamızı oldukça konforlu hale getirdi. Konumu da oldukça iyi bir yerdeydi; ulaşım ve çevredeki olanaklar açısından büyük kolaylık sağladı.
Nihan hanım son derece ilgili ve yardımseverdi. İletişimimiz çok hızlı ve sorunsuz ilerledi, her konuda destek oldu. Giriş ve çıkış süreci de oldukça kolay ve düzenliydi.
Genel olarak beklentilerimizin üzerinde bir deneyim yaşadık. Rahat, temiz ve huzurlu bir konaklama arayan herkese gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye edebilirim. Tekrar konaklamaktan memnuniyet duyacağımız bir yer oldu.

Eve giriş yaptığımızda her şey çok düzenliydi ve otel şartlarına göre gayet güzeldi. Tabii ki kendi evimiz gibi pırıl pırıl olmasını beklemiyorduk ancak yine de konforluydu. Konumu ise kesinlikle mükemmel bir yerdeydi, bu yönüyle bize büyük avantaj sağladı.
Tek eksi yönü, mutfakta yemek yapmak için sıvı yağ, tuz gibi temel malzemelerin hiç bulunmaması ve kullanabileceğimiz temizlik malzemelerinin düşünülmemiş olmasıydı; sadece tencere mevcuttu. Tüm bu ufak tefek eksikliklere rağmen konumu ve genel rahatlığı o kadar iyiydi ki, yolum tekrar düşse yine memnuniyetle burada kalırım.

Amazing stay! The location is perfect, right next to Galata Tower. You step outside and you're immediately in the middle of all the action, and watching the lively street from the window was a lot of fun too.
The staff were absolutely wonderful: very friendly, responsive, and helped us with our luggage. We felt genuinely welcomed throughout our stay.
Thank you so much! We'd be happy to come back again.

Apartment faces a very busy street and it is a very loud, busy street. The restaurants stay open very late so if you are a light sleeper, this is not the place for you. Also, apart from some dishwashing liquid, no cleaning supplies are given. The location is convenient.

description: Spacious and comfortable 3-bedroom apartment with 2 bathrooms, located near Galata. The apartment features air conditioning, a fully equipped kitchen, and easy access via elevator. Perfect for families or groups looking for a convenient and central stay in Istanbul.

reviews.text:
We had an absolutely amazing stay at Marine’s apartment! My friends and I were truly impressed by everything — the apartment, the location, and Marina herself.
She was very responsive and quick to reply to all our messages, which made the whole experience smooth and stress-free. The apartment was spotless, spacious, and incredibly stylish, with a calm and quiet atmosphere — perfect for relaxing after a day in the city.
The location is unbeatable: just a 2-minute walk from the metro and Galata Tower. Everything is within walking distance — ferries, public transport, and major attractions — which made exploring the city super easy.
We highly recommend this place — it was the best accommodation we’ve had in Istanbul, and I’ve already visited the city seven times!
Amazing place in Beyoglu. Very clean and tidy. Marine was super helpful.

The ad pictures were not matched with the current pictures.
We raised the issue and the AirB&B representative asked us to upload the pictures and we have uploaded.
We are looking forward to hear back from AirB&B
Very nice place to stay, close to Galata tower. Easy access to the apartment. The floor wasn't clean but the rest was good! Height recommended place for a city treat.

Espaço confortável para descansar, com três espaçosos quartos e rápidos acessos. Cozinha equipada para refeições rápidas. À distância de uma rua da Galata Tower e muito próximo do metro. Casas de banho pequenas e um pouco sujas.

description:
Welcome to York House.

Here, we offer you warm, stylish and new rooms in the center of Istanbul, as well as a sincere and friendly service.

Our facility is five minutes walking distance to the seaside its also ten minutes walking distance to the Grand Bazaar and Beyazit Square, and fifteen minutes walking distance to Sultan Ahmet Square and Hagia Sophia Mosque.

We look forward to welcoming you and having you be our guest .

reviews.text: Çok memnun kaldık gerçekten tertemiz bir yerdi her şeyimize yardımcı oldular, sessiz sakin güzel bir yerde konumu aynı zamanda her yere ulaşımı da çok rahat. Çok memnun kaldık bir sonraki gelişimizde yine burayı tercih edeceğiz teşekkür ederiz misafirperverliğiniz için
We had a fantastic stay in Istanbul, the location was perfect and the host was responsive, welcoming and very helpful. The accomodation was a reflection of the price we paid.

We had a good stay, especially for the price. The room was simple. The biggest highlight was the host. He was incredibly friendly, responsive, and went above and beyond to make our stay easy. He carried our bags upstairs, helped arrange our taxi, booked tours for us, and even helped us with dinner plans. His hospitality really made the experience. If you’re looking for an affordable place with an exceptional host, this is a great option.

Gokhan is extremely helpful with amazing discounted food spots, discounts on taxis, and general timelines of tourist attractions. Highly recommended for bachelor's and single people. Place is worth the price if you do not mind a small bathroom with small sink.

Gökhan was a wonderful and attentive host, always ready to help and share suggestions when asked. Staying at his hotel was wonderful. The room was cosy and the view from the terrace was beautiful. Breakfast buffet was also lovely. We definitely enjoyed our stay at the York Hotel!

description:
Welcome to The oktay Houses İn İstanbul for group or family+30 ! . Privately
hotel offering the best value budget accommodation and You will love my place for open buffet breakfast pastries mother's cake every morning comfortable bed, and My place is suitable for couples, solo adventurers, business travelers. family, vacationers and large groups. oktay Houses is located in the old historic sites of Istanbul.

reviews.text: The host, Oktay, is very helpful and nice person. He speaks English. Location is great, few minutes walk from tram station and close to all attractions. You can visit all city centre tourist places by walk. Room was clean and tidy with all necessary assesories. Bathroom was also clean. Breakfast was fabulous. If you wish to visit any place do discuss with Oktay, he will guide you the best route. I would recommend staying at this place, including families. Thank you Oktay for all your hospitality.

Location was great and the host was good. It was just that everything was a little off about the room. There were no level surfaces, the sink was mounted at a 5 degree angle, there were 3 different colors of tile in the bathroom. The tiles were not for accent. They just removed some to fix plumbing and replaced the pink tiles with gray ones. Some of the outlets in the room were power stripps spackle into the wall. We cut our trip short to not stay in this hotel.

Do not hesitate to stay at Oktay place, a five stars service from the whole crew, clean, safe, amazing breakfast, family friendly, so near to everything (no need even for the tramway) you literally can walk most of tourists attraction sites, and to all major shopping bazaars…We will definitely comeback.
Excellent location walking distance to Hagia Sofia and blue mosque. Oktay is a great host
Paris hostel was good and near to all sightseeing but if you someone is planning with family then must mention your request for first floor.

description: 4 minutes to get to the metro station.you can go by bus and metro to every district of istanbul.10 minütes walk to the seaside.Sultanahmet,Taksim,Kadıköy,Karaköy you can go easily .You can go by boat to the islands.Clean and Peaceful neigborhood.

reviews.text:
I am very pleased of staying at Resit. The place is exactly as described on the photos. It feels like home, safe and peaceful area, short walk to - public transports - grocery shops (there is a great one on main street with daily fresh vegetables and fruits) - Maltepe city centre - and really like the bakery/cafe at the corner of the street with tasty baklava's.
Resit is a great host, very responsive to my questions, smooth check-in and check-out. Also, very accommodating as I needed to extend my stay.
A little note on the WiFi, it work fine, but sometime the speed drop.
I highly recommend staying at Resit place, and I would stay again for my next visit in Istanbul.
Thank you!

The host was very responsive, sent us the directions from the airport all the way to the studio (bus #, metro stops..etc) and sent his phone # in case we got lost. The studio was clean and had everything we needed (heater, washer, clean bathroom, and a kitchen). I can say that the value exceeded the price paid. Not to forget that Resit is very friendly and is always ready to help. I definitly recommend this place!

The flat with its garden is located in the East of Istanbul. It takes 7 minutes by walk to the metro "Huzurevi", also not far from airport "Sabihe Gokcen" There are some cafés and foodstores so may enjoy the evenings by Turkish culture tasting Turkish tea and coffee with candies
The flat is clean and comfortable. There is a wide and soft double bed and one single as an extra. Even you may stay here with a family it is a real good choice, also there are sofa and armchairs, TV and satellite, table some chairs and a cooker with cooking staff and washing machine. if you like cooking you may buy all required goods and prepare some meals with Turkish tea and coffee. Thanks to host he is very kind and helpful. I enjoyed staying here and recommend to other guests to do so.
This was a nice, comfortable, clean, and safe garden-level flat. Seaside is about 5 min by minibus or 15 min walk. Reşit Bey was very helpful and welcoming.

Perfect. This was my first Airbnb stay and we came all the way from Australia. I was nervous at first but Resit made everything all right. The apartment was exactly as described and the wonderful host was always available for us and helped us with anything we needed. My son spent many hours playing with the cute cats and my mother and I spent many hours enjoying a coffee or tea watching him in the garden. This place is so convenient and has access to everything. The neighbourhood has everything you need so close. We regularly went to the European side and the best and easiest way was Metro-Ferry-then tram or bus. To travel around the Asian side is just as easy. We spent quite a few days of our 2 weeks just exploring Maltepe and surrounds.
Resit and his son were always available for us and helped us so much. Their hospitality is truly the best Turkish hospitality. I recommend staying in this apartment or the other beside it completely. All your needs are met and your stay will be a good one. We thank Resit and his family for the best stay. Amazing Airbnb host and apartment.

description:
Feel right at home in this warm, inviting space thoughtfully designed in the heart of Istanbul.. This second floor one bedroom apartment blends modern comfort with everyday practicality, offering a calm and pleasant stay in one of the city’s most vibrant neighborhoods. Ideal for both short visits and extended stays.

Designed for both city explorers and remote professionals, this space places everything you need for an exceptional stay within easy reach.

reviews.text: Excellent place to work and to enjoy Istanbul! It's right around the corner from a busy street leading to Taksim Square, a 10-min walk to Galataport with its amazing seafront - the mall, great restaurants and cruiseships. Right in the middle of it all but very quiet and safe (24/7 security). Groceries literally across the street and two or three stores a few mins up the street. Lots of hills in the area - you won't need the gym for a while. Clean, spacious, good beds, big kitchen, 2 bathrooms (one toilet, one full bathroom in the master bedroom), metro/bus card provided. Very responsive host. A little weird WiFi sign up based on your passport info, otherwise 10 out of 10, we will rent it again - reasonably priced, convenient and meets all expectations for a week-long business trip.

Great place to stay for short or long period of time. The location is great, it’s 10 minutes walk from Taoism square, 5 minutes to the tram T1 and around 13 minutes to Karakoy ferry station.
The entire building is rental, so there is a concierge 24/7 in the building and they are able to help you with anything in minutes.
They provide drinking water for free for the entire stay and provide free cleaning, towels/bed sheets change every week of your stay.
Overall really nice place, great value for the money.

My friends and I stayed at NOA luxury apartments for 5 nights. It looks exactly like its pictures. Staff is very helpful and friendly. The concierge staff was great too, they are very polite and helpful despite of language barriers.
The only issue we had was there was no WiFi and it could not be fixed during our stay.
It’s super clean and tidy and very well kept property. Everything was available at walking distance and I am completely in love with this flat. Definitely we will stay here again in our next trip.
Highly recommended this Apartment! Perfect location, host is amazing. Filly equipped kitchen, very comfortable and clean. Everything you need is here. Would be happy to stay here again.

The apartment is exactly as pictured—spacious, comfortable, and with plenty of storage, including a large closet for those traveling with extra belongings. Check-in and check-out were quick and seamless. The building has 24/7 security, and the staff are friendly and helpful. It’s located in one of Istanbul’s trendiest neighborhoods, surrounded by charming cafes and restaurants. Exploring the area is a delight, and Galataport is just a few minutes away. A wonderful place to stay!

description:
✨A Stylish & Comfortable Escape in the Heart of the City

Located in central Şişli — just a 5-7 -minute walk to the metro — our modern 2+1 bedroom apartment is within walking distance to Nişantaşı’s elegant boutiques, cafes, and vibrant streets.
Enjoy the comfort of home with chic design, a fully equipped kitchen, and stunning city views.
Whether you’re here to explore or unwind, this space offers a perfect stay in Istanbul.

reviews.text: This place is very comfortable, roomy, lots of closets and drawers to fit all your things, very clean, well-equipped, reliable wifi with high speed, in sisli neighborhood, close to many nice cafes and restaurants, shopping malls, metro station (5 mins walk) bus station (3 min walk) and anything you may need. But the best of all, is the way it is managed. Aref is always a text away! Responds fast and acts immediately to provide what you may need. There are some ladies there always cleaning the hallways, stairs and elevator. Nice smell and sparking clean is my memory of my stay there.

Nice, comfy, well equipped and clean apartment in the very heart of Istanbul. The owner and his assistant are very pleasant and responsive guys. The apartment building is brand new. There’s a coffee shop and a small grocery store downstairs. 5 min walk there’s a big and very popular among local youngsters beer place, called Yapicredit Bimonti Ada with draft beer and nice food. There’re many other good quality Turkish and western style coffee and food locations for very reasonable price nearby. We enjoyed our stay overall. On the downside the neighborhood is a little bit busy and noisy during day time but this is normal for the central locations in Istanbul. Evenings were quiet.

We had a great time staying at Kaan's place. It felt very secure and cozy. Kaan and his assistant are very nice people, very kind and open. They are always ready to help, even late at night! The apartment was perfect, very clean, with all the things you might need, even shampoo and shower gel, it has beautiful panoramic windows, so the apartment is very bright. the hallway and elevator are beautiful and smells very nice as well🥰 the area is very enjoyable, downstairs there is a convenient store, the shop seller is a very friendly man, bus station is 3 min walk, subway station is 10 min walk, closest Carrefour is 10 min walk and grocery store 1 min walk, countless diners around. We really enjoyed our staying at this apartment and it was very sad to leave.

Kaan and his place are wonderful. Impeccable host, impeccable place, very convenient location with quick access to Istanbul city center via metro, only a few minutes walk away. Room very comfortable, shower perfect, wifi superb. Couldn't ask for better, or for more.

I spent a month in this flat with my family. The hosts AriF (and the owner, Kaan) are extremely helpful, responsive and kind. The flat is in a very good location and a few stops away from most of the touristic attractions.
The flat is clean and in a good condition and guarantees a comfortable stay.
You would get an excellent service and timely response from the hosts.

description:
Charming apartment in the heart of Istanbul. Just 2 minutes away from amazing restaurants, cafes, bars, shops, and so much more. Unbeatable location with Galata Tower, Istiklal Street and Galataport only minutes away. The Blue Mosque and Grand Bazaar are 20 min away.

Perfect for weekend getaway, work-from-home alternative, or cozy home base while exploring everything Istanbul has to offer.

reviews.text: It was our second staying in Galateia residence. Apartment was amazing with everything included. Much bigger than the photos. Very clean, cozy atmosphere, excellent location near to Istiklal street. Fully equipped apartment with super comfortable beds. Working space with excellent internet connection. Also subscription for Netflix was a very good surprise. Hosts are super, ready to help on anything you need. We fully recommend it not only for vacations but also for work, as we worked from there.

Things we liked:
This location is exceptional, central to main areas and transport but down a quiet road. The hosts were very responsive and helpful and the apartment is in a secure building.
Things that need improving:
The cleanliness of the apartment, beds, furniture cutlery and crockery.
Poorly stocked kitchen, no toaster, dish towel, dish drying rack etc.

Stayed at the apartment for three weeks in the winter, great location -- quiet, yet close to Galata tower and Istiklal avenue, subway station is steps away, lots of shops and food places nearby. The apartment itself is quite large and roomy, very warm inside (about 27C), everything in accordance with the description and the photos. Reception is available around the clock, all of our questions and requests were answered promptly.

Perfect location, very good Wi-Fi (was really important for us as we were working remotely for some time), really good and fast support from the host whenever you need something. All facilities are kept in decent condition.
Excellent value and excellent location. Great communication from the managers, and I really appreciated having laundry facilities on site.

description:
10 minutes to Kadıköy by car.
You can use the entire roof duplex. There is an air conditioning downstairs and upstairs.
We do not accept reservations without Airbnb.

reviews.text:
Great place to stay with all the amenities you'll ever need. Kitchen was fully equipped and the BBQ on the balcony (however small) was a plus (though if you know how to work with charcoal BBQs, it's all you need).
The apartment was very clean and had very comfortable sofas, good TV (with Netflix subscription and cable). Emirhan is very friendly and responsive as a host. The neighborhood is a little dull and there's not much going around, but the place is a gem.
Compared to the other places I have stayed in in Turkey, Emirhan's place was the nicest. 100% recommended!

I have stayed for 5 months at Emirhan’s place. Everything was as described in the listing, communication with Emirhan was great. He was always available in case I needed anything and has been very friendly. Everything necessary for a long-term stay was present. The location was perfect for me as it was in the exact middle between my work and the city centre. There are multiple shops and bus stops nearby as well as cafés and bakeries. I would definitely recommend it for someone that does not necessarily want to be in Istanbul’s crowded centre but still close enough to reach it easily. You can get a real “home” feeling.
Konumu, temizliği, rahatlığı, iletişimi kısacası her yönüyle çok memnun kaldık.

Ev çok temizdi. Vadedilen her şey mevcuttu. 2 kişi remote şekilde çalıştık, internet gayet yeterliydi. Gönül rahatlığıyla kendi evinizde yapabileceğiniz her şeyi yapabilirsiniz. Emirhan Bey de çok kibar ve bir isteğiniz olduğunda çok yardımcı oluyor. Herkese öneririz çok memnun kaldık

We lived in an apartment for four. The apartment is small for such a large family. Ideal accommodation for 2-3 people. However, the apartment is well equipped, there is everything you need for a comfortable stay: a lot of dishes, microwave, oven, dishwasher. There is a shop near the house. It takes about 30 minutes to get to the center, there are several bus stops near the apartment, which is convenient. The apartment is well decorated and very comfortable. Thank you Emirkhan for a nice vacation!

description:
Newly renovated 3-bedroom flat on the 1st floor in Taksim, the most convenient location of Istanbul.
It has 3 double bedrooms, a living room and a big dining and working area. It has one full bathroom with a WC and an additional WC .
A fully equipped kitchen will let you to cook your meals and coffee etc.

The location of the flat is amazing , just 5 minutes away from the Taksim Square, Taksim Subway, İstiklal street and airport shuttle bus stop.
There are also plenty of shops nearby the flat.

reviews.text:
The apartment is ideal for a group, spacious, well-equipped, and even offers extra amenities such as filtered drinking water, a smart TV, and strong internet throughout. The rooms are comfortable and clean, exactly as described in the listing. The location is central and within walking distance to Taksim Square, making it very convenient.
Ozgur was friendly, responsive, and provided two sets of keys, which was very helpful. Although the building doesn’t have an elevator, the apartment is just one flight of stairs up, which wasn’t an issue for us.
There were a couple of small drawbacks to note: at times, there was an unpleasant odor on the street, and the neighborhood could get quite noisy at night especially during the weekends. Additionally, the toilet seat lid was not functioning properly and needs repair.
Overall, we had a great stay and truly appreciated the hospitality!

Everything was great. The accommodation is just a 5-minute walk from Taksim Square. The place looks exactly like in the pictures, and it has both air conditioning and heating. It was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed. The host was very kind and let us stay a bit longer after check-out, which we really appreciated. Would definitely stay here again!

The host is very kind, and always available for answering my texts. The place is as described in the pictures and check-in/out time was flexible. The kitchen is well equipped. We were also satisfied with the cleanness. However the neighborhood is a bit dark and messy.
In general I would try it again in the future 👍

Amazing apartment with everything you could need for your stay. The host was brilliant he booked our taxi from and to the airport. He greeted us and showed us around and any problems he was at the end of the phone. Apartment was as described and very clean and comfortable. Like home from home. It was a short walk to Taksim Square and the main shopping centre with many shops was close by. Metro station was in the square and you could easily get transport to the port, ferry terminal, grand bazaar, blue mosque and many more interesting places. We had a great time and will definitely recommend. Thanks so much to Hosts you were very helpful

The host was extremely responsive and genuinely helpful throughout our stay, making everything very smooth and easy. The apartment was exactly as shown in the pictures: clean, well-maintained, and fully equipped with all the necessary amenities. Its location is excellent, just a 5-minute walk from Taksim Square, which made it very convenient for exploring the city. I truly appreciated the comfort and the warm welcome, and I would not hesitate to stay here again. I highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul

description:
Fully furnished flat in Istanbul's first tripled towers - Dumankaya Ikon Residence.
Enjoy the view of all the view in our 2 Bedroom flat. The property is located in Atasehir not far to the city center in Asian side of Istanbul .

reviews.text: Konumu, mobilyasi ve temizligiyle cok guzel bir konaklamiydi. Cok memnun kaldik. Ali bey cok ilgili bir ev sahibi kendisinin daha oncede bir dairesinde konaklamistim ve tekrar gonul rahatlagiyla konaklamami gerceklestirdim. Ali bey'e sagladigi kolayliklar icin tesekkur ediyorum. Ev gercekten cok guzel ve luks dosenmisti lavabo temizliginden yataklara kadar hersey ust seviyeydi hicbir aksiklik yasamadik tekrardan gorusmek dilegiyle. Siddetle tavsiye edebilirim

The only thing this apartment has going for it is the gorgeous views. The floors are not clean and will turn ur socks black, it was dusty and generally unclean, very uncomfy beds. On the listing the amenities stated such as pool, sauna and gym were not available to us and it also stated private hot tub - this building does not even have hot tubs.
Ali was responsive straight away when i told him my concerns and said he would sort something for us but that never came.
The cleaning supplies were limited, a messy cupboard with things kinda thrown in a broken hoover and mop and no disinfectant or anything.
Just like the pictures, but the shower was broken and the apartment is really warm. Overall it was accurate to the pictures and was very clean.

The location is superb. There is a cafe downstairs and a carefour right next to it as well. The ferry station is close by so you can easily go to the European side.
Ali was more than helpful with everything and gave us a spotless apartment with more than necessary equipment. I would stay here again next time I come to Istanbul.
Highly recommended.
Beautiful stay the view was even nicer than the photos. The place had everything we needed and host was very quick to reply

description: Residence Inn Istanbul Ataşehir offers you well-furnished studios, spacious one-bedroom suites, suites with jacuzzi with magnificent sea views, and a Presidential Suite with many facilities such as sauna and Turkish bath. Whether you're with us for a few days, a few weeks, or a few months, your daily routine is important to us. Relax in our suites with fully equipped kitchens, separate seating areas, sofa beds, work areas, smart TVs and high-speed Wi-Fi.

reviews.text: I had an excellent stay at the Residence Inn by Marriott! The place was spotless and exceptionally well-maintained, which made me feel comfortable from the moment I arrived. The attention to detail in the cleaning was impressive, and it was clear that the hosts take great pride in keeping the place in top condition. The amenities were exactly as described, and the location was perfect. I would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a clean, comfortable, and convenient stay. Definitely deserving of 5 stars!

Сlean and comfortable hotel in a quiet, pleasant neighborhood. The receptionist was very friendly and even let us check in early, which we really appreciated. The room was nice, and the crisp sheets and blankets made it extra cozy. Just a heads-up: there’s a rooftop restaurant in the building, and the music can get pretty loud until around 1 AM (at least on Saturday night). So if you’re a light sleeper or hoping to get to bed early, it might be a bit of an issue.
The room was clean. Workers were friendly and kind. It was as it appeared in the photos.
Konumu harikaydı. Oda tam fotoğraflardaki gibiydi ve her şey vardı. Her şey çok temizdi. Çalışan çok ilgiliydi. Kendimi evimde gibi hissettim

Resepsiyonda ki uzun sacli arkadas cok kotu iletisim becerilerine sahipti malesef. 2 gun konakladik ve 2. gun odanin temizlenmesini istedik. 30dk onceden cikis yaptigimizi bildirdik. tam 2 saat sonra geldik ancak temizlik yapilmamisti. Resepsiyonda ki arkadasa sordugum zaman yaparlar diyor ama zaman vermiyor. diyorum ki bir zaman soyle ona gore burda mi bekleyelim gidelim kahve mi icelim karar verelim ama yok arkadas triplerde yapilacak diyor sure vermiyor. Mecbur tatli olmayan sekilde soylemek zorunda kalinca tamam diyo soruyorum diyo. Ben mi gidip temizlik personellerinden ne zaman temizlenecegini ogreniyim yani. bir diger konu odaya tuz limon vb istedik ilk gece 2 saat gec getirdiler 3 kere aradim. 2.gun marketten alin dedi uzun sacli arkadas resepsiyonu arayinca :). Ama bar personeliyle zaten konustugum icin getirdiler. 5 gun sonra bu yorumu yaziyorum vari. hesap edin ne kadar rahatsiz edici oldugunu.

description:
Newly renovated two bedroom, top floor condominium in the heart of Cihangir, with wonderful views of Historic Istanbul and the Bosphorus.
Designed thoughtfully to accommodate up to 5 guests, our 120 sqm. home has a large living room, a fully equipped kitchen, comfortable beds, washer/dryer and generous closet space.
Easy access to the Tram and Metro stations. 7 min. walk to Taksim Square, 5 min. walk to Kabataş ferries to visit all major historic sites in less than 10 min.

reviews.text:
This apartment was perfect for visiting Istanbul. The place was spotless and had all the things we needed. It looks exactly like the pictures and has the most fantastic views. It's in a hip area with a lot of bars and restaurants but it's not loud at all at night.
The location is amazing for visiting the sites in sultanahmet (T1 tram) and dohmabache and other cool neighborhoods (Besiktas, Taksim). It's also conveniently located by ferries.
There is also an elevator which is rare in the area. Neighborhood is hilly (as are most of Istanbul) so an elevator at the end of the day is a godsent.
The host is very responsive and helped us with airport transport. It's extremely clean and everything worked. The only thing is wifi is not strong in the bedrooms but we just pulled the router closer to the hallway and it was fine afterwards.

Ram’s place was beyond amazing! The apartment matched the description and pictures exactly if not better! The apartment was so clean with not a spec of dust anywhere! The beds and pillows were so comfortable and i loved that the apartment was divided into 2 parts, the front was the living, dining, and kitchen and the back was the bedrooms and bathroom. Lots of storage space and every need and convenience was thought of and provided for. The location couldn’t have been better and the best thing was that there is an elevator in the building. Lots of amazing restaurants, bars, shops, hammam, convenience stores, and grocery stores within minutes of walking distance. Public transport was also easily accessible as was Taksim square and istiklal street. I would definitely stay here again without hesitation on my next trip to Istanbul. Thank you so much Ram for your hospitality 😊

Our stay at Ram's place was very comfortable and everything was taken care of in a professional manner. It's an amazing location with walking distance from Istiklal St. , Galata Tower, Galata port seaside, Taksim square etc. The Akarsu street itself is such a happening place, which I am sure will be loved by youngsters. The best part is that Akarsu street is relatively flat as compared to others in tha area, which are steep slopes, so well suited for aged guests too. Moreover, the place has a lift. The apartement has excellent views, sea on one side and Galata Tower on the other.
Ram is an excellent host and proved to be very helpful and professional. She provides whatever information is required, not only about the place but in general. This is especially helpful for foreigners visiting a non English speaking country.
Check-in was very smooth as was the check out. She arranged Airport transfers at a reasonable price with comfortable ride.
Strongly recommended by me.
Thanks
Jatinder Singh

We felt very much at home in Ram’s apartment from location and views to the well-appointed space. It was quite special to wake in the morning to a wonderful view that changed throughout the day from light fog in the distance to sunny and clear to sparkling at night. Morning coffee overlooking the Maiden’s Tower in the Bosphorus or climbing into bed at night to lit views of the Aya Sophya and Galata Tower is something we will always remember. Cihangir is a lively and friendly neighborhood and though we are more advanced in years than most of our neighbors we never felt overwhelmed by noise or crowds. Ram was an extremely responsive host—the hot water went off once and the elevator stopped working one day—however these issues were taken care quickly and did not spoil our stay. On the down side, the Wi-Fi really only worked well in the living/kitchen area and the shower ought to be updated to match the rest of the apartment. Still, we would return again.

The apartment was a really good size. Good location and had all the amenities. Easily accessible from taksim square. Took us a few days to figure out it was just one straight street up instead of going up and down the random streets.
There were a few drawbacks. The lift in the building was broken for the first few days. There were ants in the apartment, which might be due to the heat. There was a bad odour coming from the kitchen sink. And lastly the bedding wasn’t as comfortable.
Ram was very responsive to whenever I messaged about anything and tried her best to resolve any issues or problems.

description: Our apartment is in the center of Kadıköy's new entertainment and shopping venues,within walking distance to the Marmaray and high-speed train station,Close to all means of transport, the Altıyol bull and ferry port,the historical Kadıköy bazaar. 30m2, including unlimited wi-fi, furnished, private bathroom/wc, air conditioning, Led TV, kettle, mini fridge, sitting group. There is no elevator in our building. Kitchenette in common area. ınternet speed 100mpbs

reviews.text: I had a great staying at Gokalp's place (no.302) for a month. The room (302) is very spacious and cozy for a long-term staying. The room was very cleaned and properly maintained, and of course there were still small things needed to be fixed (e.g., bedstand lamps and the light on the top of bathtub). Also, Irem was very responsive and service-minded to your questions and inquiries. Plus, the location of the apartment is very close to the central of Kadikoy and there are so many good cafes and restaurants surroundnig the area. Last, the public transportation including metros and ferries are also easy to access with some minutes of walking distance. As a whole, I would definitely recommend this room to all and I am looking forward to come back and stay at here again.

The room is perfect for longer stays: Kadikoy is just an incredbile place to live. It's vivid and full of shops, bars and restaurants. Very close to the ferry that can take you to the european side. Everything is cheaper and more peaceful on the asian though :)
Two things that are actualle concerning are: no cleaning service (we stayed for 2 months) which can be difficult due to bedsheets changing and lack of detergents (nobody buys a 4 bottles od chemics during that kind of stays) and very poor wi-fi on the second floor. The ground floor wi-fi was ok, but the second floor was horrible: we were asked to connect to other networks, but we really did it all and nothing worked (we had 2 months to figure it out and we are programmers - we really knew how to do that, it didn't work). Not useful for work, but it is ok if you want to scroll IG and so on. We used a phone internet though.
Still: that place is a 5-star rated for us! Gokalp is very communicative and was responding quickly. It was a pleasure to stay there. Highly recommended :)

I stayed more than a month and loved it. Big and spacious, calm (overlooking interior courtyard), and very well located (10min walking from ferrys or marmarail).
The street is very nice, with many cafes and a lovely atmosphere :)
Only minus could be the kitchen in the next building which is not convenient but I was eating outside.
Wi-Fi was so so but enough for me.
Overall very good, and host very responsive (he waited me around midnight for my arrival because my flight was late)
Will come back in the future!

I stayed at standard room 2 for a month in September 2023 and enjoyed the staying. The location was at the outskirt of Kadikoy central area, which was perfect for me providing me of easy acess to the central area and quiteness at the same time. And the apartment has many good local restaurants, bakeries and supermarkets around it making my daily life very convienient. The room was well renovated and clean and spacious for one or two persons and the host was responsive.
I greatly enjoyed my stay here and would stay again. The apartment is located on a lovely street with good cafes and places to eat. The apartment is spacious and comfortable.

description: This place offers its guests a practical and joyful stay. Among the artworks, you will feel yourself in an oriental fairy tale. Although the apartment is located in the most central place you could ever find in Istanbul, it also manages to be peaceful with its balcony in the greenery, where you can enjoy your drinks and meals. This place will meet all your needs and make you feel at home.

reviews.text:
The place is very well-located and the host was very cordial and helpful, accommodating our request for early check-in. The only issues I found were:
- no AC and the apartment gets very hot;
- Wi-Fi only works in the living room;
- building gate is always open during the day and night...
I had a good time in Istanbul but felt like the place should’ve been better for the price we paid

The apartment is very nice and clean. There is a bit of noise coming from the main avenue in the living room, but that cannot be avoided, and the rooms (located on the other side of the flat) are much quieter. The only negative point, in our opinion, is the bathroom, as the water pressure is very weak. Most importantly, the apartment is ideally located to take advantage of Besiktas, Ortaköy, Taksim, and explore the Bosphorus and the Asian side. The host is very accommodating and responsive.

Pros:
Good location with easy access to facilities and public transportation.
Nearby Havaist bus station for direct trips to Istanbul and Sabiha airports.
Cons:
Very low water pressure in the bathroom and bathtub.
Inconvenient check-in and check-out times conflicting with the initial information.
Wi-Fi was completely unavailable for a day with no compensation from the owner.
Disruptive morning noise from the offices downstairs, eliminating the need for an alarm.

Deniz hanıma cok teşekkür ederiz öncelikle.Evin konumu çok merkezi bahçeşehir üniversitesinin karşısı,çarşıya çok yakın.İskeleye otobüs duraklarına da aynı şekilde.Son anda bulmamıza rağmen kısa sürede dönüş yaptı ve rez onaylandı.Ev çok temiz ve kullanışlı.Klima yok biraz sıcak oluyor ama odalarda tavanda vantilatör var bir esinti katıyor.Mutfak ve banyo da yine aynı şekilde temiz kullanıslı,biz cok kullanmadık ama cay kahve makinası vs her sey var.Girişimiz de kolay oldu geç saatte gelmemize rağmen kolayca çözdük.Teşekkürlerr hep böyle anlayıslı iletişim rahatlıkla kurabileceğimiz ev sahipleryle karsılasmak dileğiylee

Very cozy, well-organized, and clean place, you have everything you need, the messages were answered immediately, Deniz is a great host.
The location is amazing, public transport, close to everything even taking into account that Istanbul is huge! We were very glad to stay in this apartment.
PS for someone who travels a lot and stays at Airbnb - there is a shower gel, laundry detergent, salt pepper, oil and other amenities, so you really feel at home

reviews.text: Ramazans place met our expectations. It was especially nice that the house was clean. Ramazan and Ahmet were helpful and easy to communicate with. The house is situated in a gated community in a rural area with chickens running around. The chickens and the little garden made us feel like we were staying at a little nostalgic farm. Groceries are easy to get in the nearby stores. Unfortunately the TV reception and the internet connection were substandard. Other than that our stay was perfect.

Diğer yorumlarda temiz denmiş ama evde aylardır birikmiş toz ve kir vardı. Sadece biz girmeden nevresimler değiştirilmiş yerler süpürülüp silinmiş. Mutfak tezgahı ve masası silinmemişti. Sinekler masa üstünde kalanların üzerine toplanmıstı. Ev sahibine görselleri de ilettim. Tuvalet kağıdı ve rulo kağıt yedek bile bırakılmamıs. Normalde Airbnb ev kalitesi bu şekilde değil. Bölgede cok sinek var kapıyı açıp içeri girene kadar ev sinek doldu. Konum sizi yanlıs yere götürüyor ev sahibi bunu bildigi halde biz geldik diye arayana kadar bunu bize bildirmedi. Yolumuz uzamıs oldu. Bunların dışında tüp bitince aradıgımızda ev sahibi 10 dk içinde gelip destek oldu. Genel anlamıyla ev iyi olsa da en önemli konu temizlik oldugu için biz pek memnun kalamadık.

Ramazan was very helpful from reservation to leaving. His house was very clean. You could find all kinds of tools in the kitchen. Wifi speed was good. If i want to stay Çatalca again, i would definetly prefer his place.
Ramazan bey rezervasyon dahil tüm süreç boyunca bize çok yardımcı oldu. Ev tertemizdi. Isınma problemi yoktu. Mutfakta her türlü malzeme mevcuttu. O bölgede konaklamam gerekirse tereddütsüz tekrar tercih ederim.

Merhaba,
Öncelikle ev mükemmel, temizlik, eşyalar falan çok iyi. Konum insandan uzak doğaya ve kafa dinlemeye bire bir. Ev sahibi ise ilgili ve dürüst. Açıkçası tekrar gitmek isteriz ilk fırsatta. Önceki yorumlar da yol bilgisi kötü denmiş fakat şöyle yol yağışlı hava da kötü olabiliyor ama alt sürtme vs söz konusu değil. Sevdiklerinizle mükemmel bir zaman geçirebileceğiniz yer olacağına emin olabilirsiniz.

Amazing view, soundless, relaxing, near to the beach thrue the romantic road. Very comfortable and cosy house. Also there are two guards - a very kindles dogs Kangal - 2 girls. Thanks for everything to Ramazan's brother called Ahmed . Surely we will be back again.

description:
Istanbul is one of the oldest cities in the world. This is a vibrant, colorful, beautiful city with a rich history. You can start exploring this magnificent city with the La Porte de Taksim. In the apartment, you can feel the peace of your home and find pleasure and comfort together.


La Porte de Taksim is 3 minutes walk from Taksim Square, which makes it easy to reach wherever you want to go.

There is reception 24 hours to answer your questions.

reviews.text: Clean and tidy hotel , very close to taksim square and easy access to metro.
This was a wonderful stay, perfect location and nice and clean rooms. It is close to the havabus stops at taksim, taksim metro and of course, the ever buzzing istiklal street. Great value for money!
Very nice hotel with great value and very good service and location
Very clean, great location, room is little small but is great compared with price .

La Porte de Taxim is a great place - from its location in the heart of the modern city, through the great hospitality of Orhan and of course - the aesthetic and comfortable rooms. Thank you once again, Orhan! We'll be back :)

description: This stylish place to stay is perfect for group trips.

reviews.text:
The home was really pretty in a pretty locality, Shops around a 400M walk away. Beach around 1Km away.
Having a private vehicle could be a great idea here. Overall amazing stay for the price. Good value for money.
A small note to the host, not a complaint. There should be some alternative bed sheets and pillow covers available for guests more than a week, a fair ask imho. Again, it's a small knitpick.
over-all a amazing stay, 9/10. recommended. Why the -1, is it pretty far away from the mainland Istanbul (a 3 hour bus connects you to the European side of Istanbul).
if that doesn't concern you, 10/10.

We stayed as a family and had a wonderful time. The place was peaceful, clean, and perfect for both adults and kids. We especially enjoyed the pool, the children’s playground, and the many adorable cats around the property. Kaan was an excellent host always quick to respond and helpful at any time. Highly recommended stay in Şile.

Site ve çevresi denizle yakınlığı havuz gayet güzeldi evde güzeldi ancak duvarlarda döküntüler vardı biraz bakımsız buldum ve klima şart mutfak gereci çok eksik el sabunundan başka temizlik malzemeside yoktu bunlar dışında olumluydu

kendi evimizde gibi bir tatil yaşadık. hem çocuklar hem de bizim için çok konforlu ve güzel bir tatildi.ev tertemizdi, komşularımız çok güler yüzlüydü. bir daha ki sene de kesinlikle tercihimiz olacak. her şey için teşekkur ederiz.

super schöne Gegend und 10 Minuten zu Fuß zum schönen Sandstrand. Auch Lebensmittel zu Fuß schnell zu erreichen.
Wir konnten freundlicherweise einen früheren Check-In machen, danke dafür!
Leider ist die Couch im Wohnzimmer ein wenig in die Jahre gekommen und hart. Ansonsten waren die Betten im Schlafzimmer bequem.
Für einen entspannten Kurzurlaub sehr zu empfehlen!

description:
Our apartment has air conditioning, internet, smart TV, Netflix, YouTube. There are all the utensils to eat. Very close to Nisantasi valikonağı street, centrally located. 7-8 minutes walk to Ismanbey metro station.
IMPORTANT NOTE: SMOKING IN THE HOUSE IS STRICTLY PROHIBITED. IF YOU SMOKE IN THE HOUSE, THE FINE IS $300.
In accordance with local law, in order to notify the identity notification system, all our guests are required to show their ID or passport before entering the home. Otherwise, the guest will not be accepted.

reviews.text:
Ömer beye burdan bir daha teşekkür ediyorum, bütün sorularımla çok hızlı ve profesyonel ilgilendi ki dairede zaten bir eksik yoktu. Odanın temizliği de mükemmeldi. Konumu da süperdi, hem çok merkezi hem çok sakin bir sokakta olması güzel. Bir kaç metre ilerde 2 tane geceye kadar açık olan market de var.
Sadece giriş kapısında tavanın alçak olması ve dairenin kapısına giden merdivenlerin biraz dar olması çok büyük veya engelli olan insanlar için biraz sıkıntı ola bilir ama bunlar dışında çok iyi ve uygun fiyatlı bir odadır.
Temizliğe önem veriyorsanız, eşya konusunda eksiksiz bir daire bekliyorsanız ve son derece ilgili ve yardımsever bir ev sahibi istiyorsanız gönül rahatlığıyla kiralaya bilirsiniz burayı. 💯
Ev gayet temizdi, güzel bi muhit, metroya çok yakın. Ömer Faruk bey mesajlara kısa sürede cevap verdi yardımcı oldu. Teşekkür ederim.
Uzun süreli konaklamalar için uygun olmayabilir fakat bir kaç günlük konaklamalar için çok ideal. Herşeyden önce çok temiz bir evdi. Konumu çok güzel bir yerde. Teşekkür ederiz :)
Great location and super clean.
Evin konumu cok merkeziydi. Evde ihtiyac olabilicek hersey mevcut. Memnun kaldim.

description: Our newly built place in the center of Kadıköy offers a modern and comfortable life. The bedroom and bathroom are together. The whole place is all yours. There are no common areas. All items are new. We offer a safer accommodation service because it has a steel door. The room has a large double bed, television, air conditioning, refrigerator, table, armchair, wardrobe, bedside table, kettle and welcome tray.

reviews.text:
The location is easy to find and the host is responsive and kind.
However, the room is 2.5/5.
The bed was comfortable and clean. The toilet was clean as well.
However, the room needs a lot of maintanence. There are permanent stains on the flooring, the bare tiles look dirty. There was a black stain near the enterance of the bathroom, which made us feel uncomfortable. I tried wiping it off but it did not come off. The walls are stained and electrical cables hang out. I think they are still in the process of renovating so night lanterns were not installed.
One of the towels unfortunately had hair left-over, which I did not use. Lack of amenities in the bathroom as well.
Overall, I rate my stay 3/5. With the price range, it is a reasonable option, but a lot can be improved with just some basic effort.
Great place with a very convenient location! The host was very friendly and helpful, and the apartment had everything we needed for a comfortable stay 🙂‍↕️

Beklentiyi çok yüksek tutmamak lazım bir aile yeri değil fiyatına göre bir yer konum itibari ile ciddi bir park problemi var otopark fiyatları faiş konumu bir o kadar güzel kısa süreli konaklamalar için tercih edilebilir.

Great place to stay the location is perfect the room is clean the price is affordable
Recommend!

Great location. I was expecting spacious corner room as like photos but in fact the room i got was hotel like small room. But it was still ok for short stay. Would have been better to have more clear description about the size of room.

description:
You can watch the panoramic sea view, passing of the ferries from the living-room of our flat. It has been completely renovated and has provided all the furniture you need so available for long-term stays too.
It is located in the center of Kadıköy, which is the most popular place in Istanbul, especially for the young and everyone who likes to travel and have fun. Bazaar, shopping mall, gourmet delicacies, cafes, night clubs, pubs are only WALKING distance.

reviews.text:
Great place to stay for the reasonable price! The apartment is very comfortable, clean and well furnished, there are everything a guest might need, like towels, sheets, kitchen stuff etc. The location is also very good, both the pier and the train station are in 5-10 minutes walking, from where you can easily reach the city center and the main sites of Istanbul. There are also a plenty of cafes, grocery stores and various shops around.
And special thanks to the host - Orhan is a very friendly and nice person, he answered fast and was always ready to help with any request I had. I definitely recommend his place to other guests.

My partner & I had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb. From the moment we arrived, the host's hospitality was exceptional.
The apartment itself is comfortable and convenient! Every detail is thoughtfully considered and matches the listing perfectly. It’s clean, bright, and has all the amenities for a long 3 month stay. The apartment is a great value for your money, especially considering the location! Everything we needed was with a 5-10 minute walk with the best coffee shops and restaurants being in the Yeldegirmeni area (Kuff & Roots are two of our favorites).
Big bonus: The view is fantastic! You can see the sea, a Turkish flag 🇹🇷 and the famous Hagia Sophia in the distance 🕌.
Both hosts went above and beyond to make sure we had everything I needed. Communication was always prompt & friendly. We couldn't have asked for a better experience.
If you're looking for a fantastic place to stay in Istanbul, look no further!

It was a great place to spend a week. It's very central, only a 5 minute walk to the Kadikoy ferry terminal and Kadikoy market. The apartment itself is on the 5th floor of a building with no elevator, which is a little difficult, but the view makes up for that (as you can see in the photos). The place itself was also very nice, comfortable beds, easy internet connection and good kitchen.

As 2 nomads who live exclusively in Airbnb’s, we highly recommend this bright & spacious apartment! We’ve stayed for 1 month and love it so much that we booked it for 2 more! It’s in the perfect location in Kadikoy, only steps away from endless cafés, shops & restaurants. The view from the apartment is one of its best features! We also enjoyed dinner on the patio and AC in the living room on hot summer days. The bed is super comfortable, the shower stays hot forever, and the kitchen has everything you need to cook a nice meal! The internet has been great here too. We especially love that there is a washer/dryer inside the apartment! Everything about this place is convenient and makes us feel at home. Even the hosts! They are so kind, helpful, responsive and accommodating (they even arranged our ride from the airport & brought us a fan on our 1st day after we mentioned we prefer to sleep with one). After being here for a month, I promise this is the best Airbnb to explore İstanbul from!

This flat is a five stars for me✨🤗we lived there for a month and it felt just like our own house. It has a lovely design that gives off a homey vibe. The flat was absolutely clean, renovated and spotless✨ Orhan and his beautiful wife are very polite and friendly and were always available whenever we needed anything🌹✨✨
The location of the apartment is also very good you can travel anywhere in Istanbul. It’s close to all sorts of transportation like boats, metro, buses, etc. Additionally, there’s a big shopping center very close to the apartment which you can even see it through the apartment windows! The only downside I would say for some people could be the stairs as the unit is located on the fifth floor. we didn’t mind though. Overall highly recommend this lovely place and hope you enjoy it as much as we did🤗

description:
🏡The small wooden house, where everything has been thought of, awaits you with its garden and view.
You can have a pleasant time in the 3 meters by 2 meters heated mini pool. (The jacuzzi is out of service)

reviews.text: Fotoğraftan hiçbir fark yoktu fiyata göre olmadı gerektiği gibiydi. Ev sahibiyle iletişimde hiçbir sorun yaşamadık. Tekrar gelmek isteriz. Sessiz temiz hava ve huzuröu bir gündü.
Konum ile rahatlıkla bulduk. Girişte oldukça iyi karşılandık. Sürekli ulaşabileceğimiz, yardıma hazır kişilerde vardı. Çok temiz ve ihtiyacınız olacak bir çok şey içeride mevcut.

Ev aynı resimlerde göründüğü gibiydi, temizdi, ev sahibi sorulara hızlı cevap verdi ve gereken yönlendirmeleri yaptı. Çok huzurlu bir ortam, tam kafa dinlemelik. Mutfak çok kullanışlıydı. Bu keyifli deneyim için çok teşekkür ederiz.

Merdiven ve Sahanlıklara sağlam değildi veya bir insanın yükünü kaldırabilecek sağlamlıkta olduğunu düşünmüyorduk. Zaten Sahanlık da kırıldı. Sağlam değildi. Sürekli düşme korkusu yaşıyorduk. Mutfak kirliydi. Çatal bıçaklar tencereler yağlıydı bezler kirli ve kıllıydı. Banyo kirliydi ve kokuyordu. İçerinin ilaçlanması gerekliydi ama sürekli böcekler vardı sanırım gerekli ilaçlamalar yapılmamıştı. Bahçesi güzeldi manzarası güzeldi. İlgili ve kibar insanlardı. Sadece daha fazla bakıma ve temizliğe ihtiyacı var bir de peyzaj ve yolun yapılması gerekiyor. Araç giriş çıkış için çokta güvenli ve uygun değildi

İçeride tüm ihtiyaçlarımız vardı, temizlik çok iyiydi. Yardıma ihtiyacınız olursa 1-2 dk içinde yanınıza gelebilecekleri mesafedeler. Merdivenler biraz zorladı bizi o kadar. Temizlik konusunda şüphelerimiz vardı ilk defa konaklama yaptığımız için ancak gerçekten çok temizdi. Teşekkür ederiz.

description:
Welcome to our unique group-friendly home in the heart of Istanbul!
This listing combines two full apartments (1st + 2nd floor) within the same historic building, creating a spacious setup ideal for large families and groups of up to 15 guests.

What You’ll Love
🛏 7 bedrooms with comfortable beds
🚿 Multiple bathrooms
🏛 High ceilings & historical architecture
🛗 Elevator
🌆 Only 250m to Taksim Square & metro station — perfect base for exploring the city

reviews.text:
We booked two apartments for our group of eight, and each person had their own bedroom, which was perfect for us. The apartments were very warm, clean, and cozy. All the necessary amenities were provided, including towels, paper towels, detergents, and coffee.
The location is excellent - the metro, bus, ferry, and tram are all within walking distance, as well as many attractions and shops. The apartments are in great condition and look exactly like the photos.
We had no issues during our stay. The host was very responsive, quickly answering all our questions and even sharing helpful information about tourist attractions in Istanbul.
We had a wonderful vacation and would definitely recommend staying here!

Our stay at the house was quite positive overall. We did encounter a few challenges, like running low on plates and essentials. Thankfully, the staff swiftly restocked them. The washing machine also had a leak, but they fixed it the same day.
The location suited us well, and the WiFi was consistently reliable. However, there was an issue with the elevator - it was small and unconventional. Despite our concerns, we still used it. One night, three people got stuck, and it was distressing due to the elevator's size. The stairs were a bit of a hassle, especially with heavy items like water.
What disappointed us most was the host's response during this elevator incident. Despite frantic messages and calls, we received no reply. The trapped individuals were stressed, stuck for over an hour. We saw our messages were read but got no response. We had to seek help from neighbors to rescue them, which left us disappointed.

A great location if you don’t mind the noise from the busy streets at night, and the flats were both spacious and clean. A highlight was the living area in particular. Unfortunately we arrived with the toilet not working and having been left in process of getting fixed, and there was some broken glass in the living room carpet. However, the host was responsive to our messages and sorted these issues out fairly quickly which was appreciated. Overall, a good stay and would recommend but you need to be okay with loud noises throughout the night.

In terms of location, it’s in the best spot on istiklal Street. The building has an elevator, which is a big advantage since most houses in the area don’t have this option. It’s a significant point because you won’t have to go up and down the stairs several times a day. The apartment is clean, well-organized, and has a good design. The landlord is responsive and very flexible.thank you Cordo🤗

Overall we enjoyed our trip. The home had an elevator which was a huge plus for us. We had a family reunion with four generations present at the home. Kids had plenty of space to run around and the couch fit all of us without any constrains. Table was roomy and we had great meals together!
The biggest issue for us were the windows - the host really need to update the windows - windows are not sealed and were letting the noise and the smell of cigaret smoke through. We really hated it. If you are traveling with small kids, it will be hard to keep the rooms dark and quiet. The cigaret smoke can’t be aired out because it’s everywhere outside.

description: Long Term Rental! A very cosy and comfortable apartment with all the conveniences you could hope for. Location is ideal, an easy walk into Beyoglu with all its bars and restaurants.Fantastic Golden Horn view awaits and you feel as if you are flying with the seagulls!

reviews.text:
+ fantastic view on Istanbul/Bosporus
+ perfect and early information from apartment owner regarding check-in details and use of photos of apartment building on whatsapp for eased finding
+ location very close (footwalk) to city center (Istiklal Cadessi) and bus/ metro station
+ apartment well furbished with classic features, e.g. tables, couch, etc.
+ technical features in apartment fully working (WiFi, electricity, gas, warm water, etc)
+ housekeeping did a good job (additional drink water bottle, fresh and clean blankets)
+ rest room and shower absolutely clean and tidy as the entire apartment
+ owner of apartment really friendly and willing to answer questions for help
+ beautiful oriental tiles on the ground
- apartment smaller and older than expected from pictures. The pictures of the website indicated a more modern and high-quality state of the apartment than it actually was.
- not suitable for guests who are really sensitive for noises. The windows are modernized with double-insulated window glasses but the old frames of the building still allow unwanted flow of air into the apartment (noise/ cold air). Since the radiator in the living room did not work during our stay it could get really cold there.
- apartment is located in 5th storey without a lift. Guests with smaller children in strolleys should consider that.
- due to the fact that it is an old apartment in its core structure we could hear the footsteps and other noises from our neighbors very well. People who are sensitive to noise should consider that.
- two tiles in the main floor were broken when we arrived and could have hurt your feet under bad circumstances.
Conclusion:
Despite several points for optimization we are really grateful to Hatice for her hospitality and would recommend her apartment for stays during spring/summer/fall times. Thank you, Hatice!

Pros: wonderful views, clean apartment, safe quiet area, host had provided a large container of filtered water
Cons:
Wasn’t as we were expecting:
1) the photo of the living room shows 4 armchairs, whereas we found there were 2 armchairs and a single bed which was not good for our party of three adults as the single bed was hard to sit on comfortably for any length of time;
Also, 2) there was king size bed in one of the rooms which was right next to the wall with no gap at the side or bottom of the bed. This meant that one of us had to clamber over the other if we needed to use the toilet in the middle of the night.
3) the host had described the apartment as being “very close distance” to “Suleymaniye mosque, Blue mosque, and Hagia Sophia. The reality is these are all on the other side of the Bosphorous Strait, and in order to get to that area you have to walk about ¼ mile to catch the Tünel funicular, then catch the metro. It isn’t difficult and is all part of experiencing Istanbul, but I would say that it wasn’t very accurately described and this aspect might bother some people.
4) I nearly tripped fell down the steep spiral staircase because the one of the lights above the stairs (which are triggered by sensing movement and operate on a timed basis) went off too early for me leaving me in darkness suddenly when I wasn’t expecting it, and it made me misjudge my next step because the spiral stairs are unregulated compared with regular stairs.
5) The description of air conditioning in the apartment is a bit exaggerated as there is only one for the whole apartment and it is not that powerful, so I don’t think it would be able to cool the apartment down much in the summer months.

Stayed at the GOLD Istanbul Deniz Apartment. Pictures are accurate with regards to the view and a further plus, the living room in the Gold apartment contained a very comfortable day bed (unlike the picture depicted for it), which was a nice surprise. We spent a week at the apartment.
Pro: views, very clean flat, affordable and close to Istiklal Street, close to a taxi stand & authentic Hammam (Buyuk Hammam) also built by Mimar Sinan of Suleymanyi Mosque Fame.
Cons: the stairs for my 75 yo Father, despite transit being easily accessed it required several transfers to get to the Sultanahmet area, air conditioning could be improved as once the bedroom doors close they get stuffy quickly.

We really appreciated all the help Hatice gave. She also left a very nice jar of fresh cherries in the fridge as a welcome. In the past most host have left an information binder in their apartment that provide some information about the area (ex. supermarket, best restaurants, local attractions etc) which was not provided and would have been a lovely touch. I think in the past Hatice was so readily available at her Cafe nearby that these questions were answered personally by her, but it was Ramadan and her Cafe was closed so I did not get to speak to her as often and felt a little reticent about bothering her so frequently to ask these questions. Perhaps a binder with this info in the apartment would be useful? Overall very happy with this lovely space.

I’m in love in this apartment! The view is incredible! And Hatice such a good host! She is amazing! She was so helpful and kind. You can feel love in all details in the flat. It’s very comfortable and well equip! There are everting: tea, coffee, sugar, all kitchen staff. All very clean! The location is really best here. I know Istanbul very very well))) The street is very quite (which is very important here) but it’s 5-7 min from Istiklal and metro. Also bus satiation just 5 min walk. And you can walk to Karakoy just 15-20 min. So it’s perfect! The building is old (I don’t like new, it’s different atmosphere) and beautiful. The lobby of the house and stairs decorate with pictures and it’s so lovely and cozy ❤️ I hope I’ll have chance to book Hatice’s apartment again, it’s perfect!

Hatice was an excellent host, with easy communication before our arrival, including organising transfers from Ataturk Airport. The apartment is as depicted in the photos and the view from the windows is as amazing as the photos suggest - breathtaking.

The place was very clean and all amenities were working and available for use. Hatice supplied bottled water - even though Istanbul's water is safe to drink - and also provided an Istanbulkart - an Oyster-like card system for public transport - very handy to have to add money to for travellers on the integrated system - and as it can be used for multiple travellers, all 4 of us could use it.

The apartment is a short walk away from many of Istanbul's sights and is close to the Tunel for connecting to the Golden Horn etc. We walked a lot around all areas and felt very safe returning to the apartment.

We also enjoyed far too many of Hatice's wonderful meals in her cafe downstairs in the apartment block - she is a terrific chef and we wish her well in her business.

This was a very positive experience and I recommend Hatice and her apartment with no hesitation.
